ruleTitle: PAGE 1 — Chapter Opening — Reorganisation ki Jhalak (PDF p.1)
conceptText: Yeh chapter hai The Age of Reorganisation — NCERT Class 7 SST kitaab Exploring Society: India and Beyond (Grade 7, Part 1) ke Tapestry of the Past section ka Chapter 6. Yeh Maurya samrajya ke baad ka daur hai — lagbhag 2nd century BCE se 3rd century CE tak. 📷 Fig 6.1.1 (detail) — Age of Reorganisation ke art ki jhalak — is daur ke alag-alag rajyon ki kala. 📷 Fig 6.1.1 — A glimpse of the art from the age of reorganisation — ek hi samrajya nahi, kai rajyon ki kala! 📷 Fig 6.1.1 — Is daur ke art pieces — har ek doosre se alag, kai alag rajyon ki pehchaan. 📷 Fig 6.1.1 — Post-Maurya kala ke n mundane examples — murtikala aur shilp. 📷 Fig 6.1.1 — Art of the age of reorganisation — sab mil kar is daur ki cultural tapestry banata hai. By continuous living tradition and a vital power of rejuvenescence, this land has readjusted itself through unnumbered transformations. — — Jagdish Chandra Bose (1917) Quote ka matlab: yeh dharti apani jeevant parampara se baar-baar khud ko naye roop mein reshapes karti rahi hai — unnumbered badlavon ke bawajood. Yahi is chapter ki aatma hai: tootna nahi, reorganise hona. 📌 THE BIG QUESTIONS — Is chapter ke 3 Bade Sawaal • Maurya samrajya ke baad ka daur kabhi-kabhi Age of Reorganisation kyun kaha jaata hai? • Us daur ke samrat kin values ya principles par chalte the? • Videshi aakranta (invaders) Bhartiya samaj mein kaise assimilate hue aur cultural confluence mein kya yogdaan diya?

text: Yeh Class 7 SST ka Chapter 6 kis daur par hai?
options: Maurya ke baad ka Age of Reorganisation
ans: Maurya ke baad ka Age of Reorganisation
explanation: Chapter 6 The Age of Reorganisation hai — Maurya samrajya ke baad ka daur (lagbhag 2nd century BCE se 3rd century CE). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh chapter Tapestry of the Past section ka hissa hai — Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Grade 7 Part 1 kitaab ka. Is daur mein Maurya ke tootne ke baad kai naye rajya samne aaye. Chapter ka naam hi is daur ki khaas pehchaan batata hai — punar-sangathan!

text: Chapter shuru hone par kaunsa quote diya gaya hai (1917)?
ans: Jagdish Chandra Bose ka
explanation: Quote Jagdish Chandra Bose (1917) ka hai — dharti ne unnumbered transformations ke bawajood khud ko readjust kiya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: J.C. Bose bade vigyanik the — unhone plant physiology par kaam kiya. Unka quote kehta hai: continuous living tradition aur rejuvenescence ki taakat se yeh dharti har badlav ke baad punar-organised ho kar uhti rahi hai. History mein bhi yahi pattern hai — empire toote, par paramparyen aage badhti hain.

text: Jagdish Chandra Bose ke quote mein dharti kya karti rahi hai?
options: Continuous living tradition aur rejuvenescence (punarjeevan ki taakat) se khud ko unnumbered transformations mein readjust karti rahi hai
ans: Continuous living tradition aur rejuvenescence (punarjeevan ki taakat) se khud ko unnumbered transformations mein readjust karti rahi hai
explanation: Quote ke anusaar dharti rejuvenescence (naya jeevan paane ki taakat) se har badlav mein khud ko readjust karti rahi hai — yani punar-sangathan! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Rejuvenescence = purani taakat wapas paana. Bharat ki itihaas mein bhi yahi hota aaya hai: Harappa toota, Vedic sanskriti aayi; Maurya toota, naye rajya ubhre. Transformation ke saath continuity — dono saath chalte hain, isliye quote itna gehra hai.

text: 3 Bade Sawaal mein se kaunsa NAHI hai?
options: Maurya ke baad ka daur Age of Reorganisation kyun kaha jaata hai?
Us daur ke samrat kin values ya principles par chalte the?
Videshi invaders Bhartiya samaj mein kaise assimilate hue?
Gupta samrajya ne kitne mandir banaye?
ans: Gupta samrajya ne kitne mandir banaye?
explanation: Gupta samrajya wala sawaal is chapter mein nahi hai — teeno sawaal reorganisation, values aur cultural confluence se hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teen Big Questions: (1) Age of Reorganisation naam kyun, (2) samraton ke values/principles, (3) videshi invaders ka assimilation aur cultural confluence. Har section inhi sawaalon ka jawab deta hai. Padhne ki trick: har rajya ko in sawaalon se jodo!

text: Fig 6.1.1 kya dikhata hai?
options: Age of reorganisation ke art ki jhalak — alag-alag rajyon ke art pieces
ans: Age of reorganisation ke art ki jhalak — alag-alag rajyon ke art pieces
explanation: Fig 6.1.1 age of reorganisation ke art ki jhalak hai — har piece alag, kai rajyon ki kala. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Is daur mein koi ek sanyukt samrajya nahi tha — Shungas, Satavahanas, Chedis, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas, Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas sabka apna art tha. Isliye art pieces ek doosre se bilkul alag lagte hain. Yahi diversity chapter ka hero hai!

text: Cultural confluence ka kya matlab hai?
options: Do sanskritiyon ka aapas mein milna aur ek doosre ko influence karna
Ek hi sanskriti ka sab jagah phailna
ans: Do sanskritiyon ka aapas mein milna aur ek doosre ko influence karna
explanation: Cultural confluence = do ya zyada sanskritiyon ka sangam — jaise Greek aur Bhartiya art ka mil kar naya style banana. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Confluence shabd nadiyon ke sangam se aata hai — Ganga-Yamuna ka sangam jaise. Yahan Greek, Shaka, Kushana aur Bhartiya paramparayein aapas mein mili — Gandhara art iska best example hai. Chapter ka teesra bada sawaal isi confluence par hai!

text: Reorganisation shabd ka matlab kya hai?
options: Punar-sangathan — naye tareeke se dobara organises hona
ans: Punar-sangathan — naye tareeke se dobara organises hona
explanation: Reorganisation = punar-sangathan — maamle (regions, powers) naye tareeke se dobara organise hona. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Jaise school mein classes reshuffle hoti hain, waise hi Maurya ke baad political powers dobara reshuffle hue — naye rajya, nayi seemaen, naye shasak. Kuch scholars isi liye is daur ko Age of Reorganisation kehte hain. Re-organisation mein re ka matlab hai dobara!

text: Assimilate hona ka kya matlab hai (invaders ke context mein)?
options: Samaj ka hissa ban jana — apna kar lena
ans: Samaj ka hissa ban jana — apna kar lena
explanation: Assimilate = samaj ka hissa ban jana — videshi aane walon ki apni pehchaan samaj mein mil jana, jaise pani mein cheeni. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Indo-Greeks, Shakas aur Kushanas yahan aaye, raj kiya — par dheere-dheere Bhartiya bhasha, dharm aur sanskriti mein assimilate ho gaye. Cheeni-pani ke misal se yaad rakho: dono mil kar alag nahi dikhte, par dono ke gun aa jaate hain. Isi ko cultural confluence kehte hain.

text: Jagdish Chandra Bose ka quote kis saal ka hai?
explanation: Quote 1917 mein likha/diya gaya tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1917 ka samay interesting tha — Swadeshi andolan ka daur, aur yehi saal jab Bose ne Bose Institute (Basu Vigyan Mandir) Kolkata mein sthapit kiya. Unka quote ek tarah se colonizers ke saamne kehta tha: yeh dharti purani hai par murda nahi — woh aaj bhi apani parampara se jeeti hai!

text: Is kitaab ka naam aur grade kya hai?
options: Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Grade 7 Part 1
ans: Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Grade 7 Part 1
explanation: Kitaab hai Exploring Society: India and Beyond, Grade 7, Part 1 — iska Chapter 6 yeh hai (Tapestry of the Past section). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nayi NCERT series mein history section ka naam Tapestry of the Past hai — tapestry matlab buna hua kapda, jaise itihaas ke dhaage milkar bade kapde jaise bante hain. Har chapter ek dhaaga hai. Grade 7 Part 1 mein geography aur civics ke chapters bhi aate hain — sab jud ke ek tapestry banate hain.

ruleTitle: PAGE 2 — Maurya ka Ant aur Naya Yug (PDF p.2-3)
conceptText: Bhavisha aur Dhruv (kitaab ke do patra) Maurya samrajya ki safar se laut kar nayi adventure ke liye tadap rahe the. Unhon ne dobara Itihasa (time-travel device) use kiya aur ek naye daur mein utre. Unhe kala ke pieces ka ek collection mila — har ek doosre se kaafi alag! Unhone socha — kya yeh artefacts kai rajyon ke the, kisi ek ke nahi? Unka andaaza sahi tha. Ab hum is lambe daur ki safar shuru karte hain… 📷 Fig 6.1.2 — Bhavisha aur Dhruv nayi kala dekh kar soch mein — kai rajyon ke artefacts! 📷 Fig 6.1.2 — Samrajya toota toh har taraf naye rajyon ke chirag jal uthe — post-Maurya vista. Ashoka ke gaddi ke waris (successors) ke baare mein bahut kam pata hai. Aam taur par maana jaata hai ki aakhri Maurya samrat ki lagbhag 185 BCE mein uske commander-in-chief (senaapati) Pushyamitra Shunga ne hatya (assassination) kar di. Isse samrajya toot gaya — Ashoka ke baad se aadhe se bhi kam samay mein! Poore subcontinent mein kai naye rajya ubhre, jo aksar Maurya samrajya ke under overlordship wale purna tributary (karak) rajya the. Northwest ilaqua kamzor ho gaya — jisse subcontinent ke bahar se invasions ke liye raasta khul gaya. Kuch scholars is daur ko age of reorganisation kehte hain, kyunki existing regions naye rajyon mein reorganise ho rahe the jo takatvar banne ke liye lagataar compete karte the. India ka naksha is daur mein kaafi badal gaya — jaise logon ki zindagi bhi badal gayi. 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Ek kagaz par timeline banao jo 2nd century BCE ke pehle saal se shuru ho kar 3rd century CE ke aakhri saal par khatam ho. Yeh period kitne saalon ka hai? (Hint: lagbhag 500 saal!) Chapter padhte-paadte is timeline par mukhya log, rajya aur ghatnayein nishaan karte jao. 📷 Fig 6.2 — Age of reorganisation mein Bharat ki prominent dynasties — Shungas, Chedis, Satavahanas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas (andar se) aur Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas (bahar se). 📷 Fig 6.2 — Naksha: Arabian Sea aur Bay of Bengal ke beech subcontinent par phaile hue naye rajya. 📷 Fig 6.2 — Naksha ka hissa: rajyon ke naam aur unki jagah — Shungas se Kushanas tak. 📌 LET'S REMEMBER Timeline banate waqt kya aapne BCE se CE mein transition notice kiya? Yaad karo Grade 6 ke chapter Timeline and Sources of History se ki itihaas mein samay kaise naapa jaata hai. BCE mein ginti peeche chalti hai (10 BCE, 9 BCE…), CE mein aage (1 CE, 2 CE…).

text: Aakhri Maurya samrat ki hatya kab aur kisne ki?
options: 185 BCE mein commander-in-chief Pushyamitra Shunga ne
ans: 185 BCE mein commander-in-chief Pushyamitra Shunga ne
explanation: Aakhri Maurya samrat ki lagbhag 185 BCE mein uske commander-in-chief Pushyamitra Shunga ne hatya kar di thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Commander-in-chief matlab sena ka sabse bada adhikari — apne hi samrat ki hatya kar gaddi lena coup kehta hai. Pushyamitra ne aisa hi kiya aur apna Shunga vansh qayam kiya. Interesting: Ashoka ke mrityu ke aadhe se bhi kam samay baad Maurya samrajya khatam ho gaya!

text: Maurya samrajya ke tootne se kya hua?
options: Poore subcontinent mein kai naye rajya ubhre — aksar Maurya ke purna tributary (karak) rajya
ans: Poore subcontinent mein kai naye rajya ubhre — aksar Maurya ke purna tributary (karak) rajya
explanation: Breakup ke baad poore subcontinent mein kai naye rajya ubhre — jo aksar pehle Maurya overlordship ke under tributary rajya the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tributary rajya = jo bade samrajya ko kar (tribute) deta hai par andar se apna shasan chalata tha. Maurya ka control kamzor hua toh yeh rajya khud ko azaad declare kar ke aur takatvar ban gaye. Isliye map itna badla — ek bada samrajya ki jagah dher saare chhote-bade rajya!

text: Maurya ke baad ka daur Age of Reorganisation kyun kehlata hai?
options: Kyunki sab kuch barbaad ho gaya
Kyunki regions naye rajyon mein reorganise ho rahe the jo powerful banne ke liye lagataar compete karte the
Kyunki sab log sheher badal rahe the
ans: Kyunki regions naye rajyon mein reorganise ho rahe the jo powerful banne ke liye lagataar compete karte the
explanation: Scholars is daur ko reorganisation isliye kehte hain kyunki regions naye rajyon mein reorganise ho rahe the — sab takat banne ki race mein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yahan reorganisation ka matlab political reshuffle hai: purani seemaen mit gayi, nayi ban gayi. Rajya lagataar compete karte the — kabhi vivah-gathbandhan se, kabhi yudh se. Itihaas mein jab bhi ek bada samrajya girta hai, us jagah aksar aisi hi reorganisation hoti hai — West mein bhi Rome ke baad hua tha!

text: Maurya ke tootne ke baad northwest ilaqua kya hua?
options: Kamzor ho gaya — jisse subcontinent ke bahar se invasions ka raasta khul gaya
ans: Kamzor ho gaya — jisse subcontinent ke bahar se invasions ka raasta khul gaya
explanation: Northwest kamzor hua — isi khaali jagah se bahar se invasions ke liye raasta khul gaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Northwest (aaj ke Pakistan-Afghanistan ka ilaqua) hamesha se Bharat ka darwaza raha hai — Alexander bhi isi raasta aaya tha. Maurya ke tootne ke baad yahan se Indo-Greeks, Shakas aur Kushanas aaye. Geography ki lesson: pahaadon ka kuan (pass) jis din kamzor ho jaye, us din itihaas badal jaata hai!

text: Bhavisha aur Dhruv kis device se time travel karte hain?
ans: Itihasa
explanation: Bhavisha aur Dhruv Itihasa naam ke device se naye daur mein utre the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Itihasa shabd Sanskrit ka hai — matlab iti (aisa hua) + haasa (vaisa hua), yani itihaas! Isi device ke through dono patra har chapter mein ek naya daur dekhte hain. Kitaab isi seekh ko aage badhati hai ki history dekhna nahi, samajhna hai!

text: Bhavisha aur Dhruv ne art collection dekh kar kya andaaza lagaya (jo sahi nikla)?
options: Artefacts kai rajyon ke the, kisi ek ke nahi
ans: Artefacts kai rajyon ke the, kisi ek ke nahi
explanation: Unka andaaza sahi tha — artefacts kai rajyon ke the, kisi ek kingdom ke nahi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Is daur ki khaas baat hi yeh thi: koi ek satta nahi, kai rajya — har ek ki apni kala! Ek jaisa samrajya hota toh art bhi ek jaisa hota. Alag-alag styles ka hona proof hai ki politically desh tukdon mein tha, par culturally phir bhi phool raha tha!

text: LET'S EXPLORE wali timeline kitne saalon ka period cover karti hai (2nd century BCE ka pehla saal se 3rd century CE ka aakhri saal tak)?
ans: Lagbhag 500 saal
explanation: 2nd century BCE ka pehla saal (199 BCE) se 3rd century CE ka aakhri saal (299 CE) tak — kul lagbhag 500 saal ka period! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ginti ka tareeka: BCE mein ginti ghat-ti hai aur CE mein badh-ti hai, isliye dono jodne padte hain — 199 + 299 lagbhag 498, yani karib 500 saal. Yeh chapter itna lamba daur isliye cover karta hai kyunki har rajya ka apna samay tha. Timeline banana history ka best tareeka hai — date ke sandarbh mein yaad rakhna aasaan ho jaata hai!

text: BCE se CE transition ke baare mein kaunsa statement SAHI hai?
options: BCE mein ginti aage badhti hai
BCE mein ginti peeche chalti hai (10 BCE se 9 BCE), CE mein aage (1 CE se 2 CE)
CE mein ginti peeche chalti hai
ans: BCE mein ginti peeche chalti hai (10 BCE se 9 BCE), CE mein aage (1 CE se 2 CE)
explanation: BCE mein ginti ghat-ti hai (5 BCE, 4 BCE, 3 BCE, 2 BCE, 1 BCE, phir 1 CE) aur CE mein badh-ti hai — zero saal nahi hota! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: BCE = Before Common Era, CE = Common Era. 1 BCE ke turant baad 1 CE aata hai — beech mein koi saal zero nahi! Isliye 2 BCE se 2 CE ke beech 3 saal ke hote hain, 4 nahi. Yeh galti sabse zyada timeline sums mein hoti hai — Grade 6 ke chapter Timeline and Sources of History se yaad karo!

text: Fig 6.2 ke nakshe mein kaunsi dynasties dikhayi gayi hain?
options: Shungas, Chedis, Satavahanas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas, Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas
ans: Shungas, Chedis, Satavahanas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas, Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas
explanation: Naksha mein nau dynasties: andar se — Shungas, Chedis, Satavahanas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas; bahar se — Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh chapter ka poora map hai: 6 vansh subcontinent ke andar se the, 3 bahar se aaye. Andar wale native the, bahar wale invaders — par dono ne milkar is daur ki cultural tapestry banayi. Naksha yaad rakho, exam mein map-based sawaal aata hai!

text: Shakas ko kis naam se bhi jaana jaata hai?
ans: Indo-Scythians
explanation: Shakas = Indo-Scythians — yeh bhi northwest se aane wale the (naksha mein likha hai). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Shakas Central Asia ke Scythian khandan se the, isliye Indo-Scythians. Indo-Greeks alag hain — Yavana/Greek. Aage padhoge: Shakas ne Shaka Samvat calendar diya jo aaj bhi rashtriya calendar hai. Naam confuse karna mana hai — Indo-Greek, Indo-Scythian, Indo-Parthian sab alag hain!

ruleTitle: PAGE 3 — Naye Rajya aur unki Competition (PDF p.4)
conceptText: Pichle chapter mein aapne Maurya samrajya ka naksha dekha tha. Upar (Fig 6.3) post-Maurya daur ka naksha hai. Dekho — us ilaqué mein kitne rajya gine ja sakte hain jo pehle Maurya samrajya ke control mein the? 📷 Fig 6.3 — Prominent dynasties of the Subcontinent — post-Maurya period ka naksha. 📷 Fig 6.3 — Naksha: andar se Shungas, Chedis, Satavahanas, Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas; bahar se Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas. Naye rajya ab territorial control ke liye compete karte the. Do raahe the: shaantipurna tareeke jaise padosi rajyon ke beech matrimonial alliances (vivah-gathbandhan), ya force ka use — yudh. Yaad rakho ki seemaon (borders) ke ilaqon par lagataar kushti chalti rehti thi, kyunki un par control paana rajya ko hamlaon se surakshit rakhne ke liye zaroori tha. In political ghatnaon ke saath-saath art, architecture aur literature ke vikas mein bhi dhamaka hua, aur cultural exchanges ne sab ko samriddh kiya. Aage ke sections mein iski jhalak milengi. ((Matrimonial alliance: aise gathbandhan jo shaadi ke through bante hain — aam taur par do shahi (royal) parivaaron ke logon ke beech. Aamtaur par iska matlab hota tha ki ek raja apni beti ka vivah padosi rajya ke shahi parivaar mein karta, taaki dono rajyon ke beech ke gathbandhan ko pakka kiya jaa sake.))

text: Naye rajya territorial control ke liye kis do tareeke se lalte the?
options: Shaantipurna tareeke jaise matrimonial alliances YA force ka use (yudh)
ans: Shaantipurna tareeke jaise matrimonial alliances YA force ka use (yudh)
explanation: Do raaste: matrimonial alliances (vivah-gathbandhan) — shaantipurna; ya yudh — force ka use. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Purane samay mein rajya diplomacy aksar shaadi se hoti thi — beti ka vivah padosi raja ke ghar kar ke do rajyon ko jodna! Isliye rajaon ki betiyaan shanti ke doot maani jaati thi. Par jab yeh kaam na kare, toh talwaar hi faisla karti thi. Aaj ke treaties aur UN jaise systems tab nahi the!

text: Matrimonial alliance ka kya matlab hai?
options: Do dosti ka imaandari se hona
Shaadi ke through bana gathbandhan — aamtaur par do royal parivaaron ke beech
ans: Shaadi ke through bana gathbandhan — aamtaur par do royal parivaaron ke beech
explanation: Matrimonial alliance = shaadi se bana gathbandhan, aamtaur par do shahi parivaaron ke beech — aksar raja apni beti ka vivah padosi raja ke ghar mein karata. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Is daur mein shaadi sirf do logon ka nahi, do rajyon ka mamla thi! Raja apni beti ka vivah padosi rajya mein karke us se dosti pakki karta. Lekin yeh beti ke liye kitna aasaan tha, yeh alag sawaal hai. Aaj ki nazar se socho: shaadi ki suchna se politics — dono ka mixture, interesting history ka paath hai!

text: Seemaon (borders) wale ilaqon par lagataar kushti kyun chalti thi?
options: Kyunki un par control paana rajya ko hamlon se surakshit rakhne ke liye zaroori tha
Wahan se koi baat nahi thi
ans: Kyunki un par control paana rajya ko hamlon se surakshit rakhne ke liye zaroori tha
explanation: Border ilaqon par control se rajya hamla se surakshit rehta tha — isi liye lagataar kushti hoti thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Border buffer zone jaisa kaam karta hai — jitna bada buffer, utna surakshit core (kendra). Aaj bhi deshon ki senaen border par hi jagah leti hain. Maurya ke baad har naya rajya chahta tha ki uski seema mazboot ho — gaddi paane ke baad pehla kaam yahi tha!

text: In political ghatnaon ke saath aur kya bhi hua?
options: Art, architecture aur literature ke vikas mein burst aaya aur cultural exchanges ne samriddh kiya
Log sheher chhod ke chale gaye
ans: Art, architecture aur literature ke vikas mein burst aaya aur cultural exchanges ne samriddh kiya
explanation: Politics ke saath-saath art, architecture aur literature ka dhamaka hua — cultural exchanges se sab samriddh hue. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ajeeb baat hai: jab politically desh tukdon mein tha, tabhi kala sabse zyada phooli! Kyunki har raja apna jag-mag karvana chahta tha — Bharhut, Karla, Gandhara, Mathura sab isi daur ki dena hai. Tension aur creativity aksar saath chalti hain — history ki yahi ajab reet hai!

text: Fig 6.3 ka naksha kis daur ka hai?
options: Post-Maurya period ka — prominent dynasties of the Subcontinent
ans: Post-Maurya period ka — prominent dynasties of the Subcontinent
explanation: Fig 6.3 post-Maurya daur ka naksha hai — jisme subcontinent ki prominent dynasties dikhti hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kitaab kahegi Maurya ka naksha pichle chapter mein tha (page 100 par). Do nakshon ka comparison karke dekho — kya farak dikh raha hai? Maurya mein ek rang, post-Maurya mein kai naam! Naksha padhna history ka basic skill hai — legend dekho, region dekho, aur time dekho.

text: Post-Maurya nakshe mein Maurya ke purane ilaqué mein kitne rajya gine ja sakte hain?
options: Kai rajya — jaise Shungas, Satavahanas, Chedis aadi
ans: Kai rajya — jaise Shungas, Satavahanas, Chedis aadi
explanation: Maurya ke purane kshetr mein ab kai rajya the — jaise Shungas, Chavanas nahi — Satavahanas, Chedis aadi, sab apni-apni jagah par. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Maurya samrajya ek bada kendriya shakti tha — ek hi chhatri ke neeche sab. Uske tootne par wahi zameen kai tukdon mein bat gayi. Ek se kai — yahi reorganisation hai. LET'S EXPLORE activity mein kitaab khud se ginne ko kehti hai — naksha khol kar ginti karo!

text: Territorial control ka kya matlab hai?
options: Kisi zameen/ilaque par shasan-karne ki taakat rakhna
ans: Kisi zameen/ilaque par shasan-karne ki taakat rakhna
explanation: Territorial control = kisi zameen ke tukde par control — kaun us par hukum chalata hai, yeh tay karna. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Territory shabd terra (zameen) se aata hai — matlab ilaqua. Har naya rajya chahta tha apna ilaqua badhe — kyunki zyada zamein = zyada kar, zyada fasal, zyada shakti. Aaj bhi desh apni seemaon par geedadapan se nibhaate hain — siachen glacier jaise chhote se tukde par bhi!

text: Vivah-gathbandhan se banne wale alliance kaunse the maayene mein?
ans: Matrimonial alliances
explanation: Shaadi se bane gathbandhan ko matrimonial alliance kehte hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Matrimonial shabd matrimony (vivah) se aata hai. Is daur mein yeh sabse sasta aur asliya tareeka tha jung se bachne ka. Ramayana-Mahabharata dono mein bhi rajniti Vivah se judi mili hai. Kitaab ka glossary isliye diya hai ki term exam mein aata hai!

text: Kis cheez ne is daur ke art, architecture aur literature ko samriddh kiya?
options: Kisi ne nahi — sab apne aap hua
ans: Cultural exchanges ne
explanation: Cultural exchanges ne art, architecture aur literature ko samriddh kiya — alag-alag paramparayein milkar naye style banayi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Exchange ka matlab aana-jaana: Greek sculpture Bharat aayi, Bharatiya deities sikke par utre, Sanskrit Persian waale likhne lage — sab aapas mein seekh rahe the. Isliye is daur ka art fusion food jaisa hai — naye ingredients, naya swaad! Chapter ka theme culture confluence hi hai!

text: Post-Maurya rajyon ke beech ka general maahaul kya tha?
options: Sab ek doosre ke dost bane rehte the
ans: Competition aur power-struggle se bhara
explanation: Rajya lagataar compete karte the — kabhi alliance se, kabhi yudh se — power struggle chalti rehti thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh daur ek competition ka daur tha: koi bhi rajya lambi chhutti par nahi tha. Isi competition mein bada woh raha jo apni seema pakki rakhta, apni kala sambhalta. Satavahanas, Kushanas — sab isi race ke winners the. Aur haan, isliye hi borders par qile aur senaayein sabse zyada zaroori thi!

ruleTitle: PAGE 4 — Shunga Vansh — Uday aur Sanskriti (PDF p.5-6)
conceptText: Pushyamitra Shunga ne Shunga vansh ki sthapana ki, jinhone uttar aur madhya Bharat ke hisson par shasan kiya. Usne aśhvamedha yajña — ek Vedic anushthan — kiya taaki khud ko sabse takatvar shasak ke roop mein sthapit kar sake. Haalaanki uska samrajya Maurya samrajya se chhota tha (dono ke naksha compare karo), usne use sambhaavit invaders se surakshit rakha aur Greecs (Yavanas) se dostana rishte banaye — unke against kuch pehle ki military campaign ke baad. Par phir bhi, uske baad samrajya zyada der nahi tika — ek saal baad hi khatam ho gaya… yani ek shatabdi (century) baad! 📷 Fig 6.4 — Rāmāyaṇa ka drishya jisme Rāma aśhvamedha yajña karte dikhe hain (19th century painting, National Museum). Is daur mein Vedic anushthanon aur practices ka punarjagran hua, par doosre vichaar-dhaaron ki aavāz bhi santrapti se chalti rahi. 📌 DON'T MISS OUT Aśhvamedha yajña ek Vedic ritual tha jo kai shasakon ne apne raja hone ka elaan karne ke liye kiya. Is ritual mein ghodi (horse) ko sipahiyon ke saath azaad chhod diya jaata tha. Jis-jis zameen par ghoda bina rokne guzar jaata, woh raja ke samrajya ka hissa maan li jaati. Agar koi shasak ghode ko rok deta, toh supremacy tay karne ke liye yudh ho jaata tha. 📌 Sanskrit, Patanjali aur Bharhut Sanskrit philosophy aur saahitya ke liye pasandeeda bhasha ke roop mein ubhri. Yaad hai Grade 6 ke Physical Education and Well-being mein Yoga Sutras ke baare mein? Inhi Yoga Sutras ko Patanjali ne is daur mein compile kiya tha! Shungas ne sahitya, kala aur architecture ko sponsorship (patronage) di. Bharhut Stupa (aaj ke Madhya Pradesh mein) Shunga kala ke khoobsurat examples pesh karta hai. Yeh shayad Ashoka ke samay bana tha, par Shungas ne khoobsurat tarashe hue railings (fence) aur reliefs jode — jin par Buddha ke jeevan ki kahaniyan chitri gayi hain. Inhe Buddhist art ke sabse purane examples maana jaata hai. 📷 Fig 6.5.1 — Bharhut Stupa ki railings — patthar par tarashe hue naqsh. 📷 Fig 6.5.2 — Railing par Lakshmi ki carving — dhan ki devi, hathiyon ke saath. 📷 Fig 6.5.3 — Gayakon aur nachne walon ka ek samooh — Bharhut ki railing par. 📷 Fig 6.5.4 — Hathi dharma ke chakra ko upar uthaaye hue — Bharhut railing relief.

text: Pushyamitra Shunga ne kaunsa Vedic ritual kiya taaki khud ko sabse powerful ruler sthapit kar sake?
ans: Aśhvamedha yajña
explanation: Pushyamitra ne aśhvamedha yajña kiya — Vedic ritual jo raja ki sarvotamta ka elaan tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Aśhva = ghoda, medha = balidaan/yajña. Ghode ko azaad chhod kar uske raahe ki zameen ko apna kehna — yeh purane smaaj ka political statement tha! Ram, Yudhishthira, Pushyamitra — kai rajaon ne kiya. Ashoka ke baad Pushyamitra ne kiya, aur isse Shunga vansh ki legitimacy mili.

text: Shunga samrajya Maurya se comparison mein kaisa tha?
options: Usse chhota, par invaders se surakshit rakha gaya
ans: Usse chhota, par invaders se surakshit rakha gaya
explanation: Shunga samrajya Maurya se chhota tha — par Pushyamitra ne use invaders se surakshit rakha aur Greeks se dostana rishte banaye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Naksha compare karo: Maurya ka vistar lagbhag poora subcontinent tha, Shunga ka sirf uttar-madhya Bharat. Chhota hona kamzor hona nahi — chhota ghar sambhalna aasaan hota hai! Pushyamitra ne Greeks ke against pehle ek military campaign chalaya, phir dosti kar li. Diplomacy + force ka mix!

text: Aśhvamedha yajña mein ghoda kaise kaam karta tha?
options: Ghoda ek mandir mein band rakha jaata
Sipahiyon ke saath azaad chhoda jaata — jis zameen par bina rok-tok guzar jaata woh raja ka maan jaata
Ghoda sabse tez daudne kacompetition jeet-ta
ans: Sipahiyon ke saath azaad chhoda jaata — jis zameen par bina rok-tok guzar jaata woh raja ka maan jaata
explanation: Ghoda sipahiyon ke saath azaad bhatakne ke liye chhoda jaata tha; bina challenge ke paar ki hui zameen raja ke samrajya ka hissa ban jaati — aur rokne par yudh hota. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh ritual ek tarah ka political challenge tha: ghoda teri seema mein ghusa aur tune nahi roka — matlab teri haar! Rok liya — toh talwaar se baat. Ashvamedha isliye bada risky bhi tha — Rama ki katha mein Luv-Kush ne ghoda roka toh yudh hua tha. Ek ghode par itni politics!

text: Pushyamitra ke baad Shunga samrajya kitni der tika?
ans: Lagbhag ek shatabdi (century)
explanation: Pushyamitra ke baad samrajya zyada nahi tika — ek shatabdi baad khatam ho gaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Isi tarah Maurya bhi Ashoka ke baad aadhi shatabdi mein hi toot gaya tha. Pattern dekho: pehla peedi mazboot hoti hai, doosri khokhli. Bharat ke itihaas mein vansh aksar 100-200 saal chalte hain — Maurya (~150 saal), Shunga (~100 saal). Isliye date yaad rakhna aasaan hai: 185 BCE se ~75 BCE tak!

text: Yoga Sutras ko kisne compile kiya aur kis daur mein?
options: Patanjali ne is post-Maurya daur mein
Adi Shankaracharya ne 8vi sadi CE mein
ans: Patanjali ne is post-Maurya daur mein
explanation: Yoga Sutras ko Patanjali ne is daur mein compile kiya — Grade 6 ke PE classes mein aap inke baare mein padhe the! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yoga Sutras ~200 BCE ke aas-paas compile hue maane jaate hain — 196 sutras mein yoga ka poora darshan. Aaj jo Surya Namaskar se International Yoga Day (21 June) tak sab chalta hai, uski jad Patanjali ki is kitaab mein hai. Itihaas ki chamatkar: shasak badalte rahe, yoga ki dhaara bahti rahi!

text: Bharhut Stupa kahan hai aur kisne usko naya roop diya?
options: Madhya Pradesh mein — Shungas ne railings aur reliefs jode
ans: Madhya Pradesh mein — Shungas ne railings aur reliefs jode
explanation: Bharhut Stupa Madhya Pradesh mein hai; yeh shayad Ashoka ke time bana, par Shungas ne carved railings aur reliefs jode jin par Buddha ke jeevan ki kahaniyan hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Bharhut = Buddhist art ka gharaana-mandir! Yahan ki railing par Jatak stories aur Lakshmi ke drishye mile hain. Ashoka ne stupa banaya, Shungas ne uski shringar kiya — do vanshon ka collaboration. Ise Buddhist art ke sabse purane examples mein gina jaata hai!

text: Bharhut ki railings par kaunsi kahaniyan tarashe gayi hain?
ans: Buddha ke jeevan ki
explanation: Railings aur reliefs par Buddha ke jeevan ki kahaniyan chitri gayi hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Buddha ke jeevan ki ghatnaayein — janam, ghar chhodna, gyan, pravachan — patthar par di gayi. Fig 6.5 mein Lakshmi ka carving bhi hai, singers-dancers bhi, aur hathi dharma-chakra uthaate hue. Ek hi jagah par kai themes: dharmik + jeevan ka anand. Bharhut mein sab milta hai!

text: Shunga daur mein Sanskrit ka kya status tha?
options: Philosophy aur literary kaamon ki pasandeeda bhasha ban gaya
ans: Philosophy aur literary kaamon ki pasandeeda bhasha ban gaya
explanation: Sanskrit philosophy aur saahitya ki pasandeeda bhasha ke roop mein ubhra — Patanjali ke Yoga Sutras bhi is daur ke hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Maurya daur mein Prakrit aur Ardha-Magadhi ka bhaari asar tha (Ashoka ke edictsh usme hain), par Shunga daur se Sanskrit ne wapas vedh li. Yeh bhasha ki rajniti hai: jis bhasha me likha jata hai, wahi shashak hote hain. Sanskrit ki laut aage Sanskrit literature ke mahakavya-jug ki neev bani!

text: Pushyamitra ke Greeks ke saath rishte kaise the?
options: Pehle military campaign, phir dostana rishte
Rishtedaar ban gaye the pehle din
ans: Pehle military campaign, phir dostana rishte
explanation: Shuruaat mein kuch military campaign ke baad dostana (friendly) rishte banaye — na ki lagataar dushmani. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Maurya ke tootne ke baad northwest mein Indo-Greeks baith gaye the. Pushyamitra samajhdaar nikla — pahadon seladoor raaste se ladai mehngi thi, isliye dosti behtar. Yeh pehla example hai is chapter mein: invaders bhi culture ke saath ghul-mil sakte hain! Chapter ka teesra big question isi par hai!

text: Shunga daur mein doosre vichaar-dhaaron (schools of thought) ka kya hua?
options: Wo bhi santrapti se chalte rahe — sirf Vedic hi nahi
ans: Wo bhi santrapti se chalte rahe — sirf Vedic hi nahi
explanation: Vedic rituals ka punarjagran hua, par doosre schools of thought bhi chalte rahe — co-existence tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Buddhist stupa (Bharhut) bhi bana, Vedic yajña bhi hua — dono saath! Isi pattern ko aage Indian ethos kehte hue dekhoge: Kharavela bhi sab sects ka aadmi tha. Bhartiya parampara mein ek hi dharm ka raja hona zaroori nahi tha — respect for all schools of thought!

text: Fig 6.4 ki painting kya dikhati hai aur kahan rakhi hai?
options: Krishna ka janam, Delhi museum mein
Ramayana ka drishya jisme Rama aśhvamedha yajña karte hain — 19th century painting, National Museum
ans: Ramayana ka drishya jisme Rama aśhvamedha yajña karte hain — 19th century painting, National Museum
explanation: Fig 6.4 mein Ramayana ka drashya — Rama aśhvamedha yajña karte hue — 19th century painting, jo National Museum mein hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Painting 19vi sadi ki hai — yani yajña ke 2000 saal baad bhi kalaakaron ne isse banaya ja raha tha! Isliye yeh painting source hai 19vi sadi ke vichaaron ka, ancient ritual ka nahi. History padhne ki kala: har source apne time ki khidki hai. Yeh painting batati hai ki aśhvamedha 2000 saal bhi zinda tha — sanskriti ki memory!

ruleTitle: PAGE 5 — Shunga Kaala — Art ka Khazana (PDF p.7-8)
conceptText: Upar ka collage (Fig 6.6) Shunga daur ki kala ka chhota khazana hai — 10 alag-alag cheezein: Greek warrior wala pillar, ek mard, bachche waali aurat, pankhi waali aurat, ek vase, baalon ke gahne waali terracotta murti, royal parivaar, sona-chatki bronze kangne, haaathi-daant ki kanga aur ek haar ke moti! 📷 Fig 6.6.1 — Greek warrior wala pillar — Shunga kala mein Greek asar! 📷 Fig 6.6.2 — Ek mard (male figure) — Shunga style ki murti. 📷 Fig 6.6.3 — Bachche waali aurat — daily jeevan ka drishya. 📷 Fig 6.6.4 — Pankhi (fan) waali aurat — Shunga terracotta art. 📷 Fig 6.6.5 — Ek vase — aam upyog ki vastu, aaj bhi kunja mein. 📷 Fig 6.6.6 — Baalon ke gahne (hair ornaments) waali murti — terracotta (miti ki) kala. 📷 Fig 6.6.7 — Royal parivaar — shahi logon ka drishya. 📷 Fig 6.6.8 — Kangne (bangles) — upar sona-chatki (gold ki patli parat) chadhi hui bronze ki! 📷 Fig 6.6.9 — Kanga — haaathi-daant (ivory) ki bani hui! 📷 Fig 6.6.10 — Ek haar (necklace) ke moti — beads. 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Neeche (Fig 6.7) Bharhut Stupa ka ek panel hai. Daayin taraf ki do figures ko dekho. Wo kya kar rahe hain? Unka profession guess kar sakte ho? Unke kapdon (attire) par dhyan do — yeh unke baare mein kya batata hai? Panel ke aur details bhi likho aur class mein apni khoj (findings) discuss karo. 📷 Fig 6.7 — Bharhut Stupa ka ek panel — do figures daayin taraf apna kaam karte hue. 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Fig 6.6 ke collage ki tasveerein dhyan se dekho. Ek note mein apne observations likho — kapdon, gahnon (jewellery), aur rozana upyog ki doosri vastuon par.

text: Fig 6.6.1 ke pillar par kya dikhaya gaya hai?
ans: Greek warrior
explanation: Fig 6.6.1 mein Greek warrior wala pillar hai — Shunga kala par Greek asar. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pillar par Greek warrior! Iska matlab Shunga daur mein Greek kalakaron ya style ka Bharat mein aana-prajaana tha. Northwest mein Indo-Greeks raj kar rahe the — kala unke through aati rahi. Cultural confluence ka chhota proof is Shunga pillar mein chhupa hai!

text: Fig 6.6.6 ki murti kis saamagri (material) ki bani hai?
ans: Terracotta (miti)
explanation: Fig 6.6.6 — baalon ke gahne waali murti — terrakotta (miti ki bakee hui) hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Terracotta = Italian mein bheje hue (baked) mitti. Sasti, aasaan banane wali — isliye aam logon ke ghar, khilone, murtiyan sab terracotta ke the. Sansadhan ki pahchaan art mein sabse zaroori sawaal hai: patthar sarkari-mahanga, mitti lokpriye. Fig 6.6.6 mein bhi wahi miti ka kamaal hai!

text: Fig 6.6.8 ke kangne (bangles) khaas kyun hain?
options: Woh bronze ke hain jinke upar sona-chatki (gold ki patli parat) chadhi hai
ans: Woh bronze ke hain jinke upar sona-chatki (gold ki patli parat) chadhi hai
explanation: Fig 6.6.8 — bronze ke kangne jinke upar sona-chatki (thin layer of gold) chadhi hui hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh ancient ka jugaad hai — sasta-andar, mehnga-bahar! Gold plating ka technique aaj bhi jewellery mein chalta hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki Shunga daur ke dastkaar metallurgy (dhaatu-vidya) mein maahir the. Aur haan — sona aur peetal dono ka mila-jula use art mein common tha!

text: Fig 6.6.9 mein dikhaya gaya kanga kis cheez ka bana hai?
ans: Haaathi-daant (ivory) ka
explanation: Fig 6.6.9 ka kanga haaathi-daant (ivory) ka bana hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ivory ke kangne-kange — aaj yeh sochna mushkil hai, par us zamane mein haaathi-daant ek khaas saamagri thi. Ivory carving India ka traditional craft raha hai (aaj restrictions hain kyunki haathi surakshit hai). Art historian ke liye material = us daur ki economy ka signal — ivory ka matlab vyaapar bhi tha, shikaar bhi!

text: Shunga art collage mein kaun-kaunsi rozmarra ki cheezein milti hain?
options: Vase, kanga, kangne, haar ke moti jaise daily-use objects bhi
ans: Vase, kanga, kangne, haar ke moti jaise daily-use objects bhi
explanation: Collage mein vase, kanga (ivory), kangne (bronze-gold), haar ke moti jaise daily-use cheezein bhi hain — sirf murtiyan nahi! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Art sirf mandir ka nahi hota — kangne aur kange bhi kala ke proof hain! Daily objects se pata chalta hai aam log kaise jeete the, kya pehnte the. Archaeologists ko yehi chhoti cheezein sabse zyada batati hain — kyunki rajaon ki kahani toh likhi jaati hai, aam aadmi ki nahi!

text: LET'S EXPLORE box (Fig 6.7) Bharhut panel mein kya dekhna hai?
options: Daayin taraf ki do figures ka kaam, unka profession aur unka attire
ans: Daayin taraf ki do figures ka kaam, unka profession aur unka attire
explanation: Bharhut ke panel mein daayin taraf ki do figures — unka kaam, profession ka guess aur unke attire (kapdon) se unke baare mein pata lagana hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh observation skill ka exercise hai — historian jaise sochna! Kapde, aasana, haath ka saamaan — sab clues hain. Agar koi dhaari-daar kapda pehenta hai toh shayad kisaan; chhata pakde toh sevak. Fig 6.7 mein do figures apna kaam karte hue dikhte hain — kya unka profession guess kar sakte ho? Class mein discuss karo!

text: Shunga daur ki kala mein Greek asar kaise aaya?
options: Greek ne Shunga vansh sthapit kiya
Northwest mein Indo-Greeks ke rehne aur cultural interaction se kala ka aana-jaana hua
ans: Northwest mein Indo-Greeks ke rehne aur cultural interaction se kala ka aana-jaana hua
explanation: Northwest mein Indo-Greeks the, unke saath cultural interaction chalta tha — isi se Greek style Bharat aayi (jaise Fig 6.6.1 ka pillar). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Border sirf siyasat ka lakshman-rekha nahi hoti — culture usse aar-paar behti hai! Shunga kalaa mein Greek warrior, Indo-Greek sikkon par Bhartiya devi-devta — dono taraf aana-jaana tha. Aage Gandhara art mein yeh milaap apni charam par jayega — Greek technique + Bhartiya vishay!

text: Fig 6.6.7 mein kaunsa drishya hai?
ans: Ek royal parivaar ka
explanation: Fig 6.6.7 mein royal parivaar ka drishya hai — shahi logon ki jhalak. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Royal family ka drishya dekh kar hum samajhte hain ki raja-log kaise dikhte the — kapde, mudrayein, aasana. Prachin kala mein raja ka darbaar banana common theme hai — kyunki kalaakar ko raja ka sponsorship chahiye hota tha! Aaj bhi portraits commission kar ke banwate hain — tradition wahi hai!

text: Shunga art ke examples kahan se mile hain (is chapter mein)?
options: Bharhut Stupa ki railings aur reliefs se, aur artefacts ke collage se
ans: Bharhut Stupa ki railings aur reliefs se, aur artefacts ke collage se
explanation: Shunga kala ke examples Bharhut Stupa (railings + reliefs) aur is page ke artefacts (collage) se mile hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kala ke do source hote hain: (1) stupa-mandir jaise monuments, (2) haath ke bane chhote artefacts — dono milke puri tasveer banate hain. Bharhut se pata chala ki Shunga patron kya dekhna chahte the; artefacts se pata chala aam log kya use karte the. Sources jitne alag-alag, itihaas utna bharosemand!

text: Collage ke artefacts dekh kar hum kya samajh sakte hain?
options: Sirf yeh ki log soorat-kismat se kaise the
Log kya pehnte the, kya gahne pasand karte the, aur kaunsi vastuein use karte the
Sirf yeh ki patthar mehnga tha
ans: Log kya pehnte the, kya gahne pasand karte the, aur kaunsi vastuein use karte the
explanation: Artefacts se pata chalta hai — kapde, gahne (jewellery), aur daily-use ki vastuein — yani logon ka jeevan-kissa! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: History sirf rajaon ke yudh ka nahi — aam aadmi ke kangne aur kange se bhi samajh aata hai! LET'S EXPLORE isi liye kehta hai ki observation note karo. Historical method ka asli raaz: chhoti cheezein, badi kahaniyan. Agar 2000 saal baad tumhara pencil mile, toh kya samjhega koi?

ruleTitle: PAGE 6 — Satavahanas — Deccan ke Shasak (PDF p.9-10)
conceptText: Shungas aksar apne padosi ilaqon ke saath yudh karte lagte the — jisme Satavahanas bhi shaamil ho sakte hain, jinhone 2nd century BCE se Deccan ke bade hisson par shasan kiya — Shunga samrajya ke daakshin (south) mein. Kabhi-kabhi inhe Andhras bhi kaha jaata hai. Yeh ek takatvar vansh tha jinke samrajya mein mukhya taur par aaj ke Andhra Pradesh, Telangana aur Maharashtra shamil the — alag-alag samay par alag-alag rajdhaniyan, jinme sabse prasiddh Amravati aur Pratishthana (Paithan) the. Satavahana rajya mein vyaapar aur vanijya (trade aur commerce) phoole-phale. 📷 Fig 6.9 — Naneghat Caves (Pune ke paas) — ek bade trade route ke kareeb. Toll aur tax jama karne aur traders ke aaraam ke liye use hoti thi. Satavahana shasakon ke sikke Bharat ke kai ilaqon mein mile hain — Gujarat se Andhra Pradesh tak — yani poorv aur paschimi (western aur eastern) dono kinaron par! Kai sikkon par jahaaz (ships) bane hain — jaisa ki is sikke par dikhta hai (Fig 6.8). Iska matlab samudri vyaapar (maritime trade) aarthik jeevan ka bada hissa tha. Sikke par dikhaye gaye jahaaz ki type advanced shipbuilding aur navigation technology ki taraf ishaara karti hai. 📷 Fig 6.8 — Satavahana ka sikka jis par do-mast (two-mast) wala samundri jahaaz bana hai. Dono mast intersecting lines se saaf dikh rahe hain — shayad padavaan (sails); neeche lehrondaar lakeerein samundar ka paani dikhati hain. Kheti (agriculture) Krishna-Godavari nadi system mein phooli — jisne rajya ko aarthik sthirta (economic stability) di. Satavahanas ke active trade networks Roman Empire tak pahunchte the — masale (spices), kapda (textiles), chandan (sandalwood), aur sona-chatke mote (gold-plated pearls), haaathi-daant (ivory) jaise luxury items ka aadaan-pradaan hota tha. Import mein kaanch (glass) aur khushbudaar ubtan (perfumed ointments) aate. Toll aur tax se rajye ko revenue mila. Aarthik samriddhi aur atyanta shaantipurna raajneetik daur ne sahitya, kala aur sanskriti ke vikas mein madad ki — jisme Satavahanas ka mahatvapurn yogdaan (significant contribution) raha. 📌 Life under the Satavahanas Satavahana parampara mein rajkumar aksar apni maa ke naam par rakhe jaate the. Isliye Gautamiputra Satakarni apni maa Gautami Balashri ke naam par tha. Woh ek takatvar rani thi jinhone Buddhist monks ko zameen daan ki aur Nashik mein ek mahatvapurn abhilekh (inscription) karwaya — jo rajya mein unke prabhav ko dikhata hai. Satavahana ka sikka jis par Brahmi lipi mein likha hai — King Lord Satakarni, son of Gautami (Fig 6.10). 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Aapke hisaab se, raja ke naam ke shuru mein maa ka naam lagaane ki parampara kya dikhati hai? Naneghat caves (Pune ke paas — Fig 6.9) mein mile doosre abhilekh ek Satavahana vidhwa rani (widow queen) par focus karte hain — jinhone aashcharyajanak roop se kai Vedic anushthan kiye — aśhvamedha yajña bhi! Abhilekhon mein Indra, Chandra aur Surya jaise Vedic devi-devtaon ka zikr hai. Rani ke daan (donations) ki bhi jhalak milti hai: zameen, gaay, ghode, haathi, chaandi ke sikke aur doosri cheezein — purohiton, mehmaanon, kaamgaaron, vidwaanon aur monks ko di gayi. Yeh abhilekh Brahmi lipi mein hain aur kuch ank (numerals) bhi hain jo kabhi-kabhi aaj ke ankon jaise dikhte hain! Yeh un kai sabooton mein se ek hai jo dikhaata hai ki aadhunik ank aakhirkar Bharat mein hi paida hue. 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Upar wale ankon ki series mein se kaunse aaj ke aadhunik ankon jaise dikhte hain? Aur kaunse nahi?

text: Satavahanas ne kis ilaqué par shasan kiya?
options: Deccan ke bade hisson par — Andhra Pradesh, Telangana aur Maharashtra
ans: Deccan ke bade hisson par — Andhra Pradesh, Telangana aur Maharashtra
explanation: Satavahanas ne 2nd century BCE se Deccan par shasan kiya — Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Maharashtra wala ilaqua. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Satavahanas ko Andhras bhi kehte the — isi naam se aaj ka Andhra Pradesh bhi hai. Shungas ke south mein unka rajya tha — doosre chapter tak padosi. Deccan ka plateau ilaqua Krishna-Godavari nadiyon se haree-bharee se maamala tha — isi ne unki economy ko zor diya!

text: Satavahanas ki do prasiddh rajdhaniyan kaunsi thin?
ans: Amravati aur Pratishthana (Paithan)
explanation: Sabse prasiddh rajdhaniyan — Amravati aur Pratishthana (Paithan); alag-alag samay par alag-alag capitals thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi vansh ke kai capitals kyun? Kyunki kai raja alag-alag samay, alag jagah se raaj karte the — Paithan (Maharashtra) godavari ke kinare, Amravati (Andhra) Krishna ke paas. Paithan aaj bhi Maharashtra ka prasiddh sheher hai — sant Eknath ki nagri. Capital badalna strategy ka hissa tha!

text: Satavahana sikkon par jahaaz (ships) kyun bane the?
options: Samundri vyaapar (maritime trade) aarthik jeevan ka bada hissa tha — isliye
Bachon ke khilone ke roop mein
ans: Samundri vyaapar (maritime trade) aarthik jeevan ka bada hissa tha — isliye
explanation: Kai sikkon par ships bane hain — matlab maritime (samundri) trade unki economic life ka bada hissa tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sikke us daur ke poster hote the — jo cheez sikke par bani, woh rajye ke liye mahatvapurn thi! Jahaaz wale sikke Gujarat se Andhra tak mile — dono kinaron par. Do-mast wala jahaaz (Fig 6.8) batata hai ki unke jahaaz kafi advanced the. Sikke padh kar history ka doosra hissa bhi khulta hai — economy!

text: Satavahana jahaaz wale sikke kis technology ki taraf ishaara karte hain?
ans: Advanced shipbuilding aur navigation technology
explanation: Sikke par dikhaya gaya jahaaz ka type advanced shipbuilding aur navigation technology ki taraf ishaara karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do-mast wala jahaaz bade samundar ke safar ke liye hota hai — ek mast wale se zyada door aur tez. Navigation = samundar mein raasta dhoondhna — suraj, taare aur kinare dekh kar. India ka samundri itihaas gambhir hai: Harappan se lekar aaj tak trade se juda hua hai. Satavahana sikke isi parampara ki pushtak-chaabi hain!

text: Satavahana rajya ki aarthik sthirta kis nadi system ne di?
options: Krishna-Godavari nadi system mein phoolee kheti
ans: Krishna-Godavari nadi system mein phoolee kheti
explanation: Krishna-Godavari nadi system mein kheti phooli — jisne rajya ko economic stability di. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do badi nadiyan — Krishna aur Godavari — ka delta do baar fasal deta hai (aaj bhi Andhra ke liye). Fasal ka matlab — anaaj, aabaadi, kar (tax). Ancient economics ka formula: nadi + kheti = khazana. Isi khazane se raja sena aur kala sambhalti hai. Geography aur history hamesha saath chalti hain!

text: Satavahanas ke trade networks kahan tak pahunchte the?
ans: Roman Empire tak
explanation: Satavahana trade networks Roman Empire tak pahunche the — spices, textiles, sandalwood aadi ke saath! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Socho: 2000 saal pehle Bharat ka maal Rome ke bazaar mein bikta tha! Export: masale, kapda, chandan, gold-plated moti, haaathi-daant. Import: kaanch aur khushbudaar ubtan. Rome ka sona Bharat jaata tha — Roman sikkon ke dher Indian sites par milne se iska proof hai. Globalisation koi nayi cheez nahi hai — sirf jahaaz badal gaye hain!

text: Gautamiputra Satakarni ka naam kis par rakha gaya tha?
options: Apni maa Gautami Balashri ke naam par
ans: Apni maa Gautami Balashri ke naam par
explanation: Satavahana parampara mein rajkumar maa ke naam par rakhe jaate the — isliye Gautamiputra Satakarni apni maa Gautami Balashri ke naam par tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Gautamiputra = Gautami ka putra! Yeh parampara maa ke maan aur mahatva ko dikhati hai — jabki zyada tar purane samajon mein sirf pita ka naam chalta tha. Gautami Balashri khud itni takatvar thi ki unhone Buddhist monks ko zameen di aur Nashik mein inscription karwaya. Socho: raja apni pehchaan maa se le — yeh apne aap mein ek bada baat hai us daur ke liye!

text: Naneghat caves ke abhilekh kis rani ke baare mein hain?
options: Ek Satavahana vidhwa rani ke — jinhone kai Vedic anushthan kiye, aśhvamedha bhi
ans: Ek Satavahana vidhwa rani ke — jinhone kai Vedic anushthan kiye, aśhvamedha bhi
explanation: Naneghat ke abhilekh ek Satavahana widow queen par hain — jinhone aashcharyajanak roop se kai Vedic rituals kiye — aśhvamedha yajña samet! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Aśhvamedha ya takat ka ritual — aur vidhwa rani ne kiya! Yeh us samaj ki khaas baat dikhata hai ki aurat ko shakti ka pad mil sakta tha. Vedic devi-devta (Indra, Chandra, Surya) ka zikr aur daan ki list — zameen, gaay, ghode, haathi, chaandi — sab abhilekh mein hai. Naneghat mein pahad ka rasta kat kar toll booth aur dharamshala banayi gayi thi — smart governance ka example!

text: Naneghat caves ka upyog kya-kya hota tha?
options: Toll aur tax jama karne ke liye aur traders ke aaraam sthal ke roop mein
ans: Toll aur tax jama karne ke liye aur traders ke aaraam sthal ke roop mein
explanation: Naneghat (Pune ke paas) — bade trade route ke kareeb — toll/tax collection aur traders ke resting place ke roop mein use hoti thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Naneghat = nane (coin) + ghat (pahaad ka rasta)! Naam hi bata raha hai ki yahan sikke (toll) jama hote the. Pahaadi raaste se guzarne wale traders se toll lo, aur unhe soné ka jagah bhi do — infrastructure + revenue ka double benefit. Aaj bhi highway toll plaza restaurants ke saath hote hain — idea 2000 saal purana hai!

text: Naneghat ke abhilekh kis lipi mein hain aur unme kya khaas mila?
options: Brahmi mein — kuch aank (numerals) jo aaj ke ankon se milte-julte hain
ans: Brahmi mein — kuch aank (numerals) jo aaj ke ankon se milte-julte hain
explanation: Abhilekh Brahmi lipi mein hain, aur unme kuch ank (numerals) hain jo kabhi-kabhi aaj ke ankon jaise dikhte hain — modern numerals ki Bharatiya jad ka saboot! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Humare 1, 4, 9 jaise ankon ki shakal Brahmi ankon se nikli maani jaati hai. Zero toh Bharat ka sabse bada tohfa hai — gravity ki tarah mathematics mein bhi! Arab traders ne in ankon ko duniya tak phailaya — isliye West mein inhe Arabic numerals kehte hain, par jad Bharat ki hai. Naneghat is ka ek chhota saboot hai — ankon wale inscription ke saath!

text: Satavahana rani ne apne daan kis-kis ko diye (abhilekh ke anusaar)?
options: Purohiton, mehmaanon, kaamgaaron, vidwaanon aur monks ko — zameen, gaay, ghode, haathi, chaandi ke sikke aadi
ans: Purohiton, mehmaanon, kaamgaaron, vidwaanon aur monks ko — zameen, gaay, ghode, haathi, chaandi ke sikke aadi
explanation: Rani ke daan — zameen, gaay, ghode, haathi, chaandi ke sikke — priests, guests, workers, scholars aur monks ko diye gaye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Daan ki list hi batati hai ki rani ke paas kya tha aur kis-kis ko us society mein izzat dete the: purohit (dharm), mehmaan (aatithya), kaamgaar (shram), vidwaan (gyaan), monk (tyaag). Ek rani ka daan-patra poore samaj ka photo jaisa hai! Isi liye historians inscriptions itne pyaar se padhte hain — ledger mein chhupi hoti hai poori kahani!

ruleTitle: PAGE 7 — Satavahana Jeevan aur Decline (PDF p.11)
conceptText: Satavahanas Vasudeva (jo Krishna ka doosra naam hai) ke shradhhalu upaasak the — haalaanki unhone doosre vichaar-dhaaron ko bhi sponsorship di, jo unke shaasan ke dauraan phoole-phale. Misal ke taur par, Satavahana raja aksar Vedic vidwaanon, Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko kar-mukt zameen (tax-free agricultural land) dete the — taaki woh apni padhai aur practices kar sakein. 📷 Fig 6.11 — Karla caves (Lonavala ke paas, Maharashtra) — jisme Satavahanas ne yogdaan diya. Yeh caves Buddhist monks ke liye bani — dekho magnificent pillars aur beech mein stupa ka patthar ka replica — sab ek chattan (rocky hillside) se tarasha gaya! 📷 Fig 6.12 — Ek yaksha (prakriti se juda minor deity) — Pitalkhora caves, Maharashtra — Satavahana period ki carving. 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Pitalkhora ka yeh yaksha apne haath par abhilekh le jaata hai — kanhadasena hiramakarena kata — matlab Kanahadasa (ek sunar) ne banaya. Kya dilchasp nahi ki ek sunar (goldsmith) patthar ki murti bhi tarasakta tha? Aapke hisaab se yeh logon ke pesha (professions) ke baare mein kya batata hai? 3rd century CE mein Satavahana samrajya chhote-chhote azaad rajyon mein toot gaya (fragmented). Iski vighatan (disintegration) mein kai kaaran the — sabse mahatvapurn kamzor central (kendriya) control aur dheere-dheere aarthik girawat (economic decline). Ek baar phir, isne regional shaktiyon ke liye raasta saaf kiya — apni ya dobara buniyad rakhne aur naye rajya sthapit karne ke liye.

text: Satavahanas kis devta ke shradhhalu upaasak the?
ans: Vasudeva (Krishna ke doosre naam) ke
explanation: Satavahanas Vasudeva — Krishna ka doosra naam — ke devout upaasak the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Vasudeva Krishna ki puja ka itna purana solid proof milta hai ki Satavahana raja is daur mein Vasudeva ko apna isht-devta maante the. Heliodorus pillar (aage) bhi Vasudeva ko god of gods kehta hai — bhakti parampara ka gehra daur. Par dhyaan do: Satavahanas ne doosre religions ko bhi aaraam diya — Vasudeva-bhakti + Buddhist caves dono ek hi vansh ke naam par hain!

text: Satavahana raja Vedic vidwaanon, Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko kya dete the?
options: Kar-mukt zameen (tax-free agricultural land) — padhai aur practices ke liye
ans: Kar-mukt zameen (tax-free agricultural land) — padhai aur practices ke liye
explanation: Raja tax-free agricultural land dete the — taaki monks aur scholars apni padhai aur practices kar sakein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tax-free zameen = regular aay ka source bina kar ke! Raja isse scholars ko support karta tha — aaj ke scholarship/fellowship jaisa. Interesting: Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko bhi wahi mile jo Vedic scholars ko mila — yahi Indian ethos hai: sab sects ko samman. Bharhut, Karla — Buddhist monuments Shunga aur Satavahana dono ke dauraan bane!

text: Karla caves kiske liye aur kaise bane the?
options: Jaina monks ke liye — lakdi se
Buddhist monks ke liye — patthar ki pahaadi (rocky hillside) mein tarasakar
ans: Buddhist monks ke liye — patthar ki pahaadi (rocky hillside) mein tarasakar
explanation: Karla caves Buddhist monks ke liye bani thi — ek rocky hillside ko taras kar, magnificent pillars aur beech mein patthar ka stupa replica! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Karla (Lonavala ke paas) chaitya grih hai — prayer hall jiska chhat beehive jaisa (lakdi ki nayi jaisi copying!). Ashokan stupa se Mathura tak — sabse badi cheez rock-cut architecture hai: patthar ko kata hai, joda nahi. Imagine karo — hammer aur chisel se poora hall! Yeh abhi bhi khada hai — 2000 saal baad bhi!

text: Yaksha kis prakar ka jeev/deity hai?
options: Prakriti se juda ek minor deity
ans: Prakriti se juda ek minor deity
explanation: Yaksha = prakriti se judi ek minor (chhoti) devta — jaise Pitalkhora ki murti mein hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yaksha-yakshini Bharat ke folk deities hain — ped, paani, zameen se jude. Bharhut ki railings par bhi yaksha-yakshini milti hai (Lakshmi bhi yakshi se sambandh). Mahan devi-devta ke saath folk pooja hamesha saath chalti rahi. Mathura art mein Kubera (yakshon ka raja) bahut banaya jaata tha — dekho Fig 6.26!

text: Pitalkhora yaksha ke haath ka abhilekh kya kehta hai?
options: Kanhadasena hiramakarena kata — Kanahadasa naam ke ek sunar (goldsmith) ne banaya
ans: Kanhadasena hiramakarena kata — Kanahadasa naam ke ek sunar (goldsmith) ne banaya
explanation: Abhilekh kehta hai — kanhadasena hiramakarena kata — matlab Sunarn (goldsmith) Kanahadasa ne banaya! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sunar ne patthar ki murti banayi — craftsperson ke liye material ka boundary nahi tha! Us daur mein kalaakar multi-skilled the — sona bhi, patthar bhi. Isliye historians ke liye inscription = artist ka signature. Aaj bhi artisans apna nishaan chhodte hain — credit dena us daur se chala aa raha hai. THINK ABOUT IT: pesha flexible tha, ek hi aadmi kai kaam karta tha!

text: Satavahana samrajya kab aur kyun toota?
options: 3rd century CE mein — kamzor central control aur dheere-dheere economic decline se, chhote rajyon mein fragmented ho kar
ans: 3rd century CE mein — kamzor central control aur dheere-dheere economic decline se, chhote rajyon mein fragmented ho kar
explanation: 3rd century CE mein samrajya chhote azaad rajyon mein toot gaya — sabse bada kaaran kamzor central control + dheere-dheere economic decline. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Har bade samrajya ka yahi kahani hai: Maurya ka bhi yahi hua, Satavahana ka bhi. Central control kamzor = raja nahi sambhalta, governor khud ke baithte hain. Economic decline = kar kam aati, fauz ko salary mushkil. Phir regional powers ubhar aate hain. Itihaas ka chakkar — yehi pattern baar-baar dohraata hai!

text: Satavahana samrajya ke tootne ke baad kya hua?
options: Regional powers ne apni ya dobara buniyad rakh kar naye rajya sthapit kiye
Ek aur Maurya vansh aa gaya
ans: Regional powers ne apni ya dobara buniyad rakh kar naye rajya sthapit kiye
explanation: Regional powers ne apni ya dobara (reassert) buniyad rakhi aur naye rajya sthapit kiye. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Reassert = wapas se assert karna. Chhote rajya jo pehle Satavahana ke under the, woh khud ko azaad samajhne lage. Yeh pattern har samrajya ke baad dohrata hai — Maurya ke baad Shunga aaye, Satavahana ke baad? Aage dekhoge. Vacuum kabhi zyada der khaali nahi rehta — koi na koi taquat poori karta hai!

text: Karla caves mein stupa ka kya khaas hai?
options: Woh ek chattan se tarasa hua patthar ka replica hai
Woh keval chitra hai, asli mein stupa nahi hai
ans: Woh ek chattan se tarasa hua patthar ka replica hai
explanation: Karla ke andar beech mein patthar ka stupa replica — sab kuch ek hi rocky hillside se tarasa hua hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chaitya-grih mein stupa hota hai jiske chhidra karke parikrama hoti hai. Karla mein stupa, pillars, chhat — sab ek hi pahaadi mein kata hua hai, jode nahi gaye! Isi ko rock-cut architecture kehte hain. Is daur mein poore India mein aisa hi kaam hua — Bharhut se Karla tak, Udayagiri tak. Patthar = India ki pustak jaisi — bas kata aur likha!

text: Satavahanas ke dauraan kala aur kisan dono ka haal kaisa tha (chapter ke anusaar)?
options: Kala aur kisan dono samriddh — Karla jaise caves bane, tax-free zameen mili
Kala chal rahi, kisan the nahi
ans: Kala aur kisan dono samriddh — Karla jaise caves bane, tax-free zameen mili
explanation: Satavahana daur mein kala-sanskriti samriddh thi (Karla caves) aur monks-vidwaanon ko tax-free zameen mili — sahitya, kala aur sanskriti ka vikas hua. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek samaj ki asli tarakki uske monuments se nahi, uske aam logon ke haal se pata chalti hai. Satavahana daur mein — trade (Rome tak), kheti (Krishna-Godavari), kala (Karla) — teeno engine chal rahe the. Kitaab kahehti hai economic prosperity ne hi kala ko paya. Culture economy ke upar khadi hoti hai — jooot pehle, phir topi!

text: THINK ABOUT IT: sunar ka patthar ki murti banana humein professions ke baare mein kya batata hai?
options: Peshe mein log sirf ek hi kaam karte the
Log kai skills rakhte the — ek sunar patthar bhi tarasakta tha
Professions ka koi matlab nahi tha
ans: Log kai skills rakhte the — ek sunar patthar bhi tarasakta tha
explanation: Yeh dikhata hai ki ek hi kaamgaar kai skills rakh sakta tha — goldsmith patthar ki murti bhi bana sakta tha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Specialization aadhi aadhunik aadat hai — purane kalaakar multi-tool the. Hathauda, chisel, aurpani — haath mein tha toh kaam milta tha. Isliye ancient inscriptions mein craftsperson ke kaam ki detail milti hai — society mein izzat bhi likhi thi. Socho: tumhara roll number ya email ID inscriptions mein 2000 saal baad dikhe toh kaisa lagega!

text: Satavahana daur mein kis bhasha ke through kala-sahitya ka vikas hua (is page ke hisaab se)?
options: Kai schools of thought — Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko bhi sponsorship, kala mein Buddhist caves jaisi den
ans: Kai schools of thought — Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko bhi sponsorship, kala mein Buddhist caves jaisi den
explanation: Vasudeva-bhakti ke saath Jaina aur Buddhist monks ko bhi tax-free zameen mili — alag-alag schools of thought phoole-phale aur Buddhist caves bani. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek raja, kai dharma, sab ko barabar support — yeh is chapter ka dohraya hua theme hai (Kharavela bhi aisa hi karega). Isi ko Indian ethos kaha jaata hai. Political power religion ko sponsor karti hai, par is daur mein kisi ne doosre ko kuchal kar ek karna nahi try kiya. Diversity + harmony = is daur ki asli taakat!

ruleTitle: PAGE 8 — Chedis — Kharavela aur Kalinga (PDF p.12-13)
conceptText: Chalo thoda peeche chalte hain. Pichle chapter ka Kalinga yudh yaad hai na? Maurya samrajya ke girawat ke baad, Kalinga ek pramukh shakti ke roop mein ubhra — Chedi vansh ke rajaon ke under. Kharavela unke mukhya shasakon mein se ek tha — Jain shikshaon ka shradhhalu anuyaayi; use kabhi-kabhi bhikshu-raja ya monk-king kaha jaata tha — haalaanki woh saare vichaar-dhaaron ka samman karta tha. Bhubaneswar ke paas prasiddh Udayagiri-Khandagiri caves — jo shayad Jain monks ke liye bani — mein naqshi panels aur murtiyan, aur chatanon mein kate hue spacious kamre hain — jo dastkaaron ki kala ka saboot hain. In caves ki design aur craftsmanship unhe rock-cut architecture ke notable examples banati hai — is style par hum unchi classes mein phir aayenge. 📷 Fig 6.13.1 — Udayagiri caves, Bhubaneswar ke paas — Jain monks ke liye banee gehui caves. 📷 Fig 6.13.2 — Hathigumpha abhilekh — Brahmi lipi mein Kharavela ke kaaron ka record. 📷 Fig 6.13.3 — Carved panel — Raamaayana ka ek drishya dikhaata hua. Ek cave mein Hathigumpha abhilekh bada-bada dikhata hai — jo Brahmi lipi mein likha hai aur Raja Kharavela ke saal-dar-saal (year after year) kaaron ko record karta hai — uske vijayee military campaigns aur apni praja ke kalyaan ke liye bhalaai ke kaam samet. Kharavela garv se kehta hai ki usne ek sau (hundred) regions se sadhu-santon ki council banayi, aur woh extraordinary virtues mein nipauna, har sampradaya ka sammaan karne wala, aur har mandir ka marammat karne wala hai. Ek baar phir — ek raja saare schools of thought ko suraksha dene ka garv leta hai. Yeh us cheez ka buniyadi hissa hai jo hum Indian ethos keh sakte hain. 📌 THINK ABOUT IT lagbhag do hazaar saal pehle patthar mein kate kamron ki regularity (barabarpan) notice karo. Kya sirf chisel aur haathode se kalaakar aisi precision kaise laate the? Khud ko us daur ka shilpi (sculptor) maan kar dekho — apne haathon se patthar ko kala mein shape karte hue. Tum kaunse auzaar use karte?

text: Maurya ke girawat ke baad Kalinga kis vansh ke under ubhra?
ans: Chedi vansh
explanation: Maurya ke baad Kalinga Chedi vansh ke rajaon ke under ek pramukh shakti ban kar ubhra. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kalinga = aaj ka Odisha. Ashoka ne Kalinga ka yudh jeeta tha (bahut khoon baha ke) — par Maurya ke tootne par Kalinga khud takatvar ho gaya. Chedi rajaon mein sabse naamwala — Kharavela. Rajniti ka pattern: jab bada samrajya girta hai, uske khandahar par purani shaktiyaan wapas jaag uthti hain!

text: Kharavela ka kis shiksha/dharm ke saath rishta tha?
options: Jain — bhikshu-raja (monk-king) tha, par sab sampradayon ka samman karta tha
ans: Jain — bhikshu-raja (monk-king) tha, par sab sampradayon ka samman karta tha
explanation: Kharavela Jain shikshaon ka shradhhalu anuyaayi tha — use bhikshu-raja (monk-king) kaha jaata tha — par sabhi vichaar-dhaaron ka samman karta tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Monk-king! Raja bhi hai, sadhu bhi — jaise do zindagi ek saath. Jain monks ke liye Udayagiri caves banwayi, par Hathigumpha abhilekh mein khud likhwaya: har sampradaya ka sammaan karne wala. Yehi dohraya hua pattern hai — Pushyamitra ne Buddhist stupa (Bharhut) sambhala, Satavahanas ne sabko zameen di. Tolerance ek political virtue maani jaati thi!

text: Udayagiri-Khandagiri caves kiske liye aur kahan hain?
options: Buddhist monks ke liye, Pune ke paas
Shayad Jain monks ke liye, Bhubaneswar ke paas
ans: Shayad Jain monks ke liye, Bhubaneswar ke paas
explanation: Udayagiri-Khandagiri caves Bhubaneswar ke paas hain — shayad Jain monks ke liye bani thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Odisha ke pahaadon mein 100+ caves hain — khaali kamre, chhote-khidki wale dariyabeeni baser. Jain monks bina saaman ke ghoomte the, bas sone ki jagah chahiye hoti thi. Udayagiri ka matlab hill of sunrise! ruleTitle: PAGE 9 — Dakshin ke Rajya aur Sangam Sahitya (PDF p.13-14)
conceptText: Bharat ke dakshini (south) ilaqué mein yeh daur — 2nd ya 3rd century BCE se 3rd century CE tak — teen takatvar rajyon ke ubharne ka gawah hai: Cheras, Cholas aur Pandyas — jo aksar ek doosre se dakshin ke control ke liye compete karte the, aur saath hi kshetr ke trade aur culture ki growth mein yogdaan dete the. Yaad karo — Ashoka ka samrajya un dakshini rajyon par ruk gaya tha (jo woh apne edicts mein mention karta hai) — iska matlab woh Mauryan power ke uchch samay par bhi independent rahe. Aur haan — Kharavela claim karta hai ki usne dakshini rajaon ki ek alliance ko haraya jo uski zameen ko dhamki de rahi thi — par us yudh ki jagah unknown hai, aur woh dakshin ke ilaqué par hamla karne wala nahi lagta. 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Agle page ke nakshé mein aap rajyon ke naam ke saath alag-alag chinh (symbols) dekh sakte ho. Yeh chinh kya represent karte hain? Socho — yeh rajyon ki alag pehchaan kaise dikhate hain? Us daur mein kai kavi aaye jinke kaamon ko mila kar Sangam literature kehte hain — isi puraare Sangam Age naam diya gaya! Shabd sangam Sanskrit ke sangha se bana hai — matlab association (sanstha) aur coming together (aana-jodna) — is sandarbh mein kaviyon ki sabha (assembly of poets). Sangam sahitya dakshin Bharat ka sabse purana hai — isme kavitaon ke kai sangrah (anthologies) hain, aur itihaas-likhakon (historians) iski khoj-khoj karte hain — jisse un samay ka samaj aur sanskriti samajh mein aata hai. Mukhya taur par Sangam kavita personal emotions (jaise prem) aur samajik values (jaise veerta aur udaarta) ko bade kaushal aur narmi se varnit karti hai. 📌 The Cholas Sangam literature mein teen crowned kings (mukutdhari raja) ka zikr hai — Cholas, Cheras aur Pandyas. Cholas ek takatvar vansh the jinhone 3rd century BCE se 13th century CE tak dakshin Bharat ke hisson par shasan kiya. Chola raja Karikala ne Cheras aur Pandyas ki milkar bani fauj ko hara kar apni sarvotamta qayam ki (is par agli page par aur!). 📷 Fig 6.14 — Kingdoms in the South — Chola, Chera, Pandya (borders approximate aur samay ke saath badalti rahin). 📷 Fig 6.14 — Naksha — Kaveri nadi, Arabian Sea aur Bay of Bengal ke beech teeno rajya. 📷 Fig 6.14 — Naksha ka chinh (symbol) — rajyon ki unique pehchaan. 📷 Fig 6.14 — Sangam kaal ke rajya chinh — THINK ABOUT IT isi par sochta hai. 📷 Fig 6.14 — Naksha ka hissa — Uraiyur, Vanji (Karur), Madurai — teeno rajdhaniyan. 📷 Fig 6.14 — Rajya ka chinh — naksha par chinhon ka arth wahi sabse bada THINK ABOUT IT hai. 📷 Fig 6.14 — Naksha detail — har rajya apne chinh se pehchana jaata tha.

text: Dakshin Bharat mein is daur mein kaun teen rajya ubhre?
ans: Cheras, Cholas aur Pandyas
explanation: Dakshin mein Cheras, Cholas aur Pandyas — teen takatwar rajya ubhre (2nd/3rd century BCE se 3rd century CE tak). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teenon Tamil ilaqué ke the — aur teenon aapas mein hi lade-jhagde aur ek doosre se badh kar aage bhi! Chera = Kerala side, Chola = Kaveri delta, Pandya = Madurai side. Tamil culture ki jad isi teenon ke beech bani. Sangam kavita inhi ke darbaar aur samaj ka chitra hai — politics aur poetry dono zinda the!

text: Dakshin ke teen rajya aapas mein kya karte the (ek saath)?
options: Dakshin ke control ke liye compete karte the, par trade aur culture mein yogdaan bhi dete the
ans: Dakshin ke control ke liye compete karte the, par trade aur culture mein yogdaan bhi dete the
explanation: Teeno rajya dakshin ke control ke liye compete karte the — par saath hi trade aur culture ki growth mein yogdaan dete the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Competition + contribution — dono saath! Jaise do school ki teams ek doosre se ladti hain par game ko famous bhi karti hain. Sangam Age ka culture isi competition mein phoola — har raja kavion ko apna darbaar mein bulata tha. Renaissance Italy ke city-states jaisa — ladai bhi, kala bhi, vyapar bhi!

text: Ashoka ke samrajya ka dakshini rajyon ke saath kya rishta tha?
options: Uska samrajya un par ruk gaya tha — woh Mauryan power ke uchch samay par bhi independent rahe
ans: Uska samrajya un par ruk gaya tha — woh Mauryan power ke uchch samay par bhi independent rahe
explanation: Ashoka ka samrajya dakshini rajyon par ruk gaya tha (edicts mein mention hai) — matlab Cheras-Cholas-Pandyas Maurya ke uchch samay par bhi independent rahe! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ashoka ke edicts mein Cholas-Cheras-Pandyas ka zikr hai — as neighbours, not as subjects! Yeh south ki continuous independence ki kahaani batata hai — dakshin hamesha apni aur chalta raha. Isi se samajh aata hai ki south mein Tamil bhasha-sanskriti ki alag lekin utni hi dher purani dhaara chali. Ek India, kai dhaaraein — tapestry phir yaad karo!

text: Sangam shabd kis Sanskrit shabd se bana hai aur iska kya matlab hai?
options: Sangha se — association aur coming together (kaviyon ki sabha)
ans: Sangha se — association aur coming together (kaviyon ki sabha)
explanation: Sangam = Sangha se — matlab association / coming together — yahan matlab kaviyon ki sabha (assembly of poets). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sangh/sangha shabd Buddhist aur Jain orders ke liye bhi use hota hai (Buddhist sangha yaad karo!). South mein kaviyon ki assemblies sangam kehlai — jahan kavita suni jaati, compare hoti aur sangrah (anthology) mein aati thi. Jaise aaj ka literary festival — par bina mic aur stage ke! Word origin (etymology) history mein bahut kaam aati hai — shabd se dhaara nikaal sakte ho!

text: Sangam Age ka naam kaise pada?
options: Us daur ke kaviyon ke kaamon ko mila kar Sangam literature kaha gaya — isliye era Sangam Age
ans: Us daur ke kaviyon ke kaamon ko mila kar Sangam literature kaha gaya — isliye era Sangam Age
explanation: Us daur ke kai kavi aaye — unke kaamon ka collection Sangam literature kaha gaya — isliye puraara Sangam Age naam mila. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Jaise India ka freedom struggle freedom fighters ke kaamon se ek naam mila, waise south ka classical era apni kavita ke naam par jaana gaya. Jis daur ko remember karne wale log kaviyon ki sabha se naamo se jodein — yeh batati hai ki us samaj mein knowledge aur kala ki izzat kya thi. Political history ke saath cultural history bhi saath chalti hai!

text: Sangam literature ke baare mein kaunsa statement SAHI hai?

Yeh dakshin Bharat ki sabse purani literature hai — kavita ke anthologies ka collection
Yeh sirf yudhon ki kahani hai
ans: Yeh dakshin Bharat ki sabse purani literature hai — kavita ke anthologies ka collection
explanation: Sangam literature dakshin Bharat ki sabse purani literature hai — poems ke kai anthologies (sangrah) par mabni. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sabse purana matlab — Tamil ki classical jad! Anthology = ek jagah kai likhai ka collection, jaise aaj ki best-of book. Historians in anthologies se us samay ka samaj, khana, vyaapar, prem aur veerta padhte hain. Kavita = history ka mirror — jab sekeile chronicles nahi hote, kavita bhi source ban jaati hai!

text: Sangam kavita mukhya taur par kis par focused hai?

explanation: Sangam kavita personal emotions (prem) aur samajik values (veerta, udaarta) ko bade kaushal aur delicacy se varnit karti hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Socho — 2000 saal purani kavita prem aur udarta dono baat karti hai! Veerta = bravery (raja-fauj ke liye), udaarta = generosity (samaj ke liye). Sangam poems mein farmer, fisherwoman, warrior, lover — sabki aavaz hai. Isliye historians isse society ka photo-album maan kar padhte hain. Kavita sirf dil nahi chhooti — history bhi likhti hai!

text: Sangam literature mein teen crowned kings kaun hain?
ans: Cholas, Cheras aur Pandyas
explanation: Sangams mein teen crowned kings (mukutdhari) — Cholas, Cheras aur Pandyas — ka zikr hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Crowned king = mudi-souvenir nahi — woh raja jo rajya-dand (sceptre) aur mukut ke saath aayojit the! Tamil tradition mein in teenon ko moovendar (three great kings) kaha jaata hai. Sangam poems inhi ke darbaaron mein bane. Jab kitab kehti hai Cholas 3rd century BCE se, toh yaad rakho — ye unke Sangam kaal ke, unke baad ke imperial Cholas (9vi-13vi sadi) bhi aage hain!

text: Cholas ne kitne samay tak shasan kiya?
options: 3rd century BCE se 13th century CE tak
ans: 3rd century BCE se 13th century CE tak
explanation: Cholas ne 3rd century BCE se 13th century CE tak — lagbhag 1500+ saal (beech mein gap ke saath) — dakshin Bharat ke hisson par shasan kiya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Cholas ka itihaas do hisson mein hai: Sangam kaal ke purane Cholas (Karikala wale) aur baad ke imperial Cholas (Rajaraja-Rajendra wale, 9vi-13vi sadi CE). 13vi sadi tak — yani Maurya ke baad bhi, Harsha ke baad bhi, bahut der tak! Isliye Cholas south ki sabse lambe-challe vanshon mein se ek hain — sadiyon ki continuity!

text: Karikala ne apni supremacy kaise qayam ki?

ans: Cheras aur Pandyas ki milkar bani fauj ko hara kar
explanation: Chola raja Karikala ne Cheras aur Pandyas ki combined fauj ko hara kar apni supremacy sthapit ki. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do vs ek — aur ek jeeta! Isse pata chalta hai Karikala kitna shatir senapati tha. Chera aur Pandya dono pehle se hi purane rivals the Chola se. Agle page par is raja ka sabse bada kaam padhoge — Kallanai (Grand Anicut) — jo aaj bhi kaam kar raha hai. Yudh jeetne wala raja engineer bhi nikla!

text: Kharavela ka dakshini rajaon ke saath claim kya tha?

Kharavela ne likhwaya toh sahi — par yudh ki location ka pata nahi, aur dakshin ke naksha par uske asar ke saboot nahi. Isliye kitaab saaf kehti hai ki woh dakshin mein invade karne wala nahi lagta.
