ruleTitle: PAGE 10 — Silappadikaram — Anklet ki Kahani (PDF p.15)
conceptText: 📷 Silappadikaram — Kannagi aur Kovalan ki katha ka chitra — nyay ki devi ke roop mein Kannagi. 📷 Fig 6.15 — Kannagi ki murti (statue), Chennai — aaj bhi Tamil Nadu aur Kerala mein pooji jaati hain. Yeh prasiddh epic (mahakavya), jo Sangam collections ke turant baad rachi gayi, Kannagi ki kahani batata hai. Kannagi apne pati Kovalan ke saath Chola rajdhani Puhar (jo Kaveripattinam ke roop mein pehchani gayi hai) mein khushi se jeeti thi. Par Kovalan ek nachne waali (dancer) se pyaar mein pad gaya aur dheere-dheere us par apna saara dhan lutaa diya. Apni galti samajh kar, woh Kannagi ke paas laut aaya — jisne use maaf kar diya. Dono phir Pandya rajya ki rajdhani Madurai chale gaye — nayi zindagi shuru karne ki umeed se. Nayi shuruaat ke liye, Kannagi ne Kovalan ko apna ek nupur (anklet) bechne ko diya; par use chori ka jhootha ilzaam lagaya gaya aur Pandya raja ne use maar diya (execute kar diya). Toot gayi Kannagi ne apne doosre nupur dikha kar uski bhalaai saabit ki. Raja ko apni galti ka ehsaas hua — aur woh jhatak (shock) se mar gaya. Kannagi ne phir Madurai ko shraap (curse) de diya — aag ke devta ko bula kar jisne sheher ko jala diya. Phir woh aur west ki taraf Chera rajya chali gayi, jahan use devi ke roop mein samman diya gaya. Aaj bhi Kannagi Tamil Nadu aur Kerala mein pooji jaati hai. Silappadikaram ki utkrusht kavita isliye nyay (justice) ke siddhanton aur raja ke dharma — jiske liye usse nyay karna zaroori hai — par focus karti hai. Yeh katha humein 3 rajyon se hokar guzarti hai — samriddh sheher, vyapaar ka maal, aur kai schools of thought bhi dikhati hai.

text: Silappadikaram kis cheez ki kahani hai?
options: Kannagi aur uske nupur (anklet) ki — nyay ki khoj ki
ans: Kannagi aur uske nupur (anklet) ki — nyay ki khoj ki
explanation: Silappadikaram Kannagi ki kahani hai — jiska matlab hai The Tale of the Anklet (nupur ki katha) — nyay ki khoj ka mahakavya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Silappadikaram Tamil ka teen maha-kavyon mein se ek hai (doosre: Manimekalai, Valayapati). Silambu = anklet, atikaram = katha. Ek gehna puri kahaani ka title hai — kyunki wahi nupur jis par jhootha ilzaam laga, wahi saabit hua saach ka saboot! Title hitheme summary hai: nyay ki talaash mein ek aurat ka safar!

text: Kannagi aur Kovalan shuruaat mein kahan rehte the?
ans: Chola rajdhani Puhar mein (Kaveripattinam)
explanation: Kahani shuru hoti hai Chola rajdhani Puhar (Kaveripattinam) mein — jahan dono khushi se rahte the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Puhar = Chola ka port sheher, jahan samundri vyaapar se sheher chamakta tha. Ek hi kahani mein teen rajya ghumna — Chola (Puhar), Pandya (Madurai), Chera (west) — yeh south India ka tour hai literature ke through! Epic ek tarah ki GPS-kahaani hai: geography, culture aur rajniti — sab ek thread mein!

text: Kovalan ka kya hua Puhar mein?
options: Ek dancer se pyaar mein pad kar saara dhan lutaa diya
ans: Ek dancer se pyaar mein pad kar saara dhan lutaa diya
explanation: Kovalan ek dancer se pyaar mein pad gaya aur apna saara dhan us par lutaa diya — phir galti samajh kar Kannagi ke paas laut aaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kavita meemsa — recovery of hero through forgiveness. Kannagi ka maaf karna us samaj ki maryada batata hai: pati ki galti ke baad bhi patni ne use apnaya. Kahaani isliye relatable hai — insaani kamzoriyan, aur phir unse upar uthta insaani garima. Sangam values (prem, maryada, veerta) isi epic mein simat kar aa jati hain!

text: Madurai mein Kovalan ka kya hua?
options: Kannagi ka nupur bechne gaya tha — par chori ka jhootha ilzaam lag gaya aur Pandya raja ne use maar diya
ans: Kannagi ka nupur bechne gaya tha — par chori ka jhootha ilzaam lag gaya aur Pandya raja ne use maar diya
explanation: Kannagi ke nupur ko bechne gaya Kovalan par chori ka jhootha ilzaam laga aur Pandya raja ne use execute kar diya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Bina jaanch-padtaal ke sazaa — yahi kahaani ka turning point hai. Raja ne suna-suna kar faisla kiya, saboot nahi dekha. Andha nyay = andha vinash. Isi se kahaani ka asli message aata hai: raja ka pehla dharma hai sach jaanna. Courtroom drama — 2000 saal purana, par aaj bhi relevant!

text: Kannagi ne Kovalan ki bhalaai kaise saabit ki?
options: Apna doosra nupur dikha kar — jisme maniyan (gems) thi, chori wale mein moti
ans: Apna doosra nupur dikha kar — jisme maniyan (gems) thi, chori wale mein moti
explanation: Kannagi ne apna doosra nupur khol kar dikhaya — uski bhalaai isi se saabit hui. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do nupur, do saboot! Jhootha ilzaam chori ka nupur par tha — Kannagi ne doosra dikha kar farak dikha diya. Ek aurat ne apne mar hue pati ki laash ke saamne raja se sach jhoothla — himmat ki asli paribhasha! Yahi scene Tamil Nadu ke murals aur Bharatnatyam mein ab bhi perform hota hai. Kavita ka dialog bada dramatic hai — Kannagi ka krodh kiye bagair sach jeetna!

text: Pandya raja ka kya hua jab use apni galti ka ehsaas hua?
ans: Woh jhatak (shock) se mar gaya
explanation: Apni galti ka ehsaas hote hi raja jhatak (shock) se mar gaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Raja ki mrityu — apne hi nyay ke failure se! Yeh kahaani ka sabse bada dhamaka hai: ek nirbal aurat ke saamne samrajya ki saari taakat sharmindah ho gayi. Silappadikaram kehti hai — nyay ki taqat raja se badi hai. Aur yahi epic ka dharma-sabak hai: raja nyay na kare toh uska apna vinash pakka hai!

text: Madurai ka kya hua (Kannagi ke shraap ke baad)?
options: Aag ke devta ne sheher ko jala diya — Kannagi ke shraap se
ans: Aag ke devta ne sheher ko jala diya — Kannagi ke shraap se
explanation: Kannagi ne Madurai ko shraap de diya — aag ke devta (god of fire) ko bula kar jisne sheher ko jala diya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Nyay ke bina bahale ke ghar mein aag — kahaani ka yaatnaatmak climax. Kannagi tapaswi ke roop mein mehfooz hai par uska krodh bhi saral hai: jo rajya ne apne praja ko nyay nahi diya, us rajya ki samaj sadhi nahi. Silappadikaram yahi kehna chahti hai — nyay hi us samaj ki safety-valve hai. Aurat ki taakat ko samajhne ke liye yeh India ki sabse purani kahaaniyon mein se hai!

text: Kannagi ka Chera rajya mein kya swagat hua?
options: Use devi ke roop mein samman diya gaya
ans: Use devi ke roop mein samman diya gaya
explanation: Chera rajya mein Kannagi ko devi ke roop mein samman diya gaya — aaj bhi Tamil Nadu aur Kerala mein pooji jaati hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek aurat jise apne hi desh mein nyay nahi mila, doosre rajya mein devi ban gayi! Kannagi ki puja aaj bhi Kerala (Mudrarakshasa temples — aattukal bhagavathy samet) mein hoti hai. Silappadikaram ne ek insaan ko utsarga (deification) mein badal diya. Kahaani khatam, par charitra amar — literature ki asli jeet yahi hai!

text: Silappadikaram kis cheez par focus karta hai?
options: Nyay ke siddhanton aur raja ke dharma par — jisme praja ko surakshit karna included hai
ans: Nyay ke siddhanton aur raja ke dharma par — jisme praja ko surakshit karna included hai
explanation: Epic ki kavita nyay (justice) ke siddhanton aur raja ke dharma par focus karti hai — nyay dena raja ka farz hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Dharma yahan sirf puja-paath nahi — rajya- vyavastha ka sahi chalana hai. Raja jo jaldi mein faisla le, uski saaza poori rajya ko milti hai (Madurai jal gaya!). Yeh political science ki kahaani kavita ke kapdon mein! Aaj bhi nyay-palika ke liye kaam karte hue log is kahaani se sabak lete hain: bina proof sazaa nahi!

text: Silappadikaram ki kahaani humein kis-kis cheez ka pata chalati hai?
options: Sirf ek jode ke baare mein
Vyapaar se samriddh sheheron, teen rajyon (Chola-Pandya-Chera) aur kai schools of thought ke baare mein
Sirf ek nupur ke baare mein
Sirf ek raja ke baare mein
ans: Vyapaar se samriddh sheheron, teen rajyon (Chola-Pandya-Chera) aur kai schools of thought ke baare mein
explanation: Kahaani vyapaar se bhare sheheron, 3 rajyon aur kai schools of thought ke beech se guzarti hai — poori cultural jhalak! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Epic ek living map hai: Puhar ka bazaar, Madurai ka rajmahal, Chera ka samman — teen rajya, teen culture. Isliye historians Silappadikaram ko source-text maante hain — kahaani ke kapdon mein asli history chhupi hai (markets, justice system, religion). Fiction bhi kabhi-kabhi fact ka record hota hai — bas padhne ki aankh chahiye!

text: Kannagi aaj bhi kahan pooji jaati hain?
ans: Tamil Nadu aur Kerala mein
explanation: Tamil Nadu aur Kerala mein Kannagi aaj bhi pooji jaati hain — devi ke roop mein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kannagi murti Chennai mein hai (Fig 6.15) aur Kerala-Tamil Nadu mein unke mandir hain. Ek kavya ka paatra 2000 saal baad bhi living worship ka vishay ho — yahi literature ki asli amaratha hai! Thailand aur Sri Lanka tak Silappadikaram ke asar ke claims hain. Aisi kahaani jo samaj ki zameer ban jaye, woh kabhi nahi marti!

ruleTitle: PAGE 11 — Karikala aur Kallanai — Grand Anicut (PDF p.16)
conceptText: 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Raja ki murti ko dekho. Woh kaise dikhaye gaya hai? Uska posture, kapde aur expression uski taakat aur status ke baare mein kya kehte hain? 📷 Fig 6.16 — Chola Raja Karikala ki murti — Grand Anicut Memorial Park, Tamil Nadu. 📷 Fig 6.17 — Kallanai ya Grand Anicut ka drishya — aaj bhi kaam karta hua paani-ka-engineering wonder! Karikala ne logon ke hit ke liye kai projects banaye. Inme se ek hai Kallanai ya Grand Anicut — ek complex paani ko moRne (water diversion) ka system jo Srirangam island ke turant neeche ek geographically strategic point par sthit hai. Yeh Kaveri ke paani ko Kaveri delta ke madhy aur dakshini hisson mein moRta hai. Isse zyada zameen kheti ke neeche laayi jaa saki — jisne is ilaqué ko rice bowl of the South (dakshin ka chawal ka katora) ka naam dilaya. Samay ke saath kai baar restore hote hue, yeh aaj bhi use mein hai aur Tamil Nadu ke karodo logon ko irrigation ka paani deta hua kheti mein madad karta hai.

text: Kallanai ya Grand Anicut kya hai?
options: Ek complex water diversion system — Kaveri ka paani delta mein moRne ke liye
ans: Ek complex water diversion system — Kaveri ka paani delta mein moRne ke liye
explanation: Kallanai (Grand Anicut) ek complex water diversion system hai — jo Kaveri ke paani ko moR kar delta ke hisson mein pahunchata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Anicut ya check-dam = nadi ke aar-paar bana eka pathar ka structure jo paani ka raasta badal deta hai. Kaveri delta ka paani isse do hisson mein bat jata tha — jisse do baar fasal. Sri Lanka ke Raja Raja bhi paani ka engineer tha — par Kallanai ka jawab nahi! Yeh Tamil civilization ka engineering-certificate hai!

text: Kallanai Srirangam island ke kahan bana hai?
options: Uske turant neeche (just downstream) ek geographically strategic point par
ans: Uske turant neeche (just downstream) ek geographically strategic point par
explanation: Kallanai Srirangam island ke turant neeche (downstream) — ek geographically strategic point par bana hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Strategic point ka matlab: jagah aisi jahan se poore delta mein paani baanta jaaye — engineering mein location hi sab kuch hai! Srirangam Kaveri ke beech ka aam-tod jaisa ilaqua hai; wahan paani do dhaaron mein bat-ta hai. Karikala ne us jod par check-dam lagaya — jaise nal ke neeche ungli rakh kar do baalti mein paani baantna! 2000 saal purani civil engineering aaj bhi pass ho rahi hai!

text: Kallanai ke banne se zameen ka kya hua?
options: Zyada zameen kheti ke neeche laayi gayi — ilaqua rice bowl of the South kehlaya
ans: Zyada zameen kheti ke neeche laayi gayi — ilaqua rice bowl of the South kehlaya
explanation: Isse zyada zameen kheti ke neeche laayi gayi — aur yeh ilaqua rice bowl of the South (dakshin ka chawal-katora) kehlaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paani + zameen = fasal! Irrigation se do-sawa bhi fasal ho sakti hai (aaj bhi delta farming ka rule). Tamil ke bawarchi khane ka sochte hain toh engineer paani ka — dono ko Kaveri chahiye! Kaveri delta aaj bhi India ke sabse bade chawal production centres mein hai. Agriculture civilization ki neev — Kallanai us neev ka concrete (patthar!) hai!

text: Kallanai aaj ka kya status hai?
options: Kai baar restore hote hue aaj bhi use mein hai — Tamil Nadu ke karodo logon ko paani deta hai
ans: Kai baar restore hote hue aaj bhi use mein hai — Tamil Nadu ke karodo logon ko paani deta hai
explanation: Kallanai kai baar restore hote hue aaj bhi use mein hai — karodo logon ko irrigation ka paani dete hue kheti mein madad karta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 2000 saal purana dam aaj bhi kaam kar raha hai — engineering ka certificate bas yahi hai! British ne bhi isko use kiya aur aage badhaya (19vi sadi mein). Kaveri delta ki fasal aaj bhi isi par depend karti hai. Ancient India sirf mandir-tower nahi tha — public infrastructure bhi uski khaas pehchaan thi!

text: Rice bowl of the South kis ilaqué ko kehte hain?
options: Kaveri delta ko — jahan Kallanai se zyada zameen kheti ke neeche aayi
ans: Kaveri delta ko — jahan Kallanai se zyada zameen kheti ke neeche aayi
explanation: Kaveri delta ko — Kallanai ke irrigation se — rice bowl of the South kaha jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Bowl mein se khaana milta hai — desh ka bowl wahi hai jahan se anaaj aata hai! Kaveri delta ki alluvial mitti + paani ka system = chawal ka jam-kar production. Aaj bhi Thanjavur ka chawal famous hai. Ek raja ka iraada karodo logon ka pet bharta hai — engineering hai toh sab hai!

text: Karikala ne projects kis liye banaye (kitaab ke anusaar)?
ans: Logon ke hit (benefit) ke liye
explanation: Karikala ne logon ke benefit ke liye kai projects banaye — jaise Kallanai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yudh jeetna ek baat, jeet ke baad praja ki seva karna doosri baat! Karikala ne apni taakat aur engineering dono praja par laga di. Raja ka asli report card = kanal, sadak, paani — sirf talwar nahi. Kalyaankaari rajya ka purana concept — Kharavela ke bhalaai ke kaamon jaisa hi - south version!

text: THINK ABOUT IT: raja ki murti ka posture, kapde aur expression kya batate hain?
options: Uski taakat aur status — murti ka har detail message deta hai
ans: Uski taakat aur status — murti ka har detail message deta hai
explanation: Murti ka posture, kapde aur expression raja ki taakat aur status ka message dete hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Murtiyan mute text hain — dekh kar padho! Khade-haath, khuli chaati, mukut, maha-astra — sab ek symbolic bhasha hai. Aaj bhi president ki photo dekh kar hum status samajhte hain. Fig 6.16 mein Karikala ko dekho: posture, expression, vahan (vehicle) — socho kya kehna chahte hain kalaakar. Visual analysis = history ki asli skill!

text: Water diversion system kya karta hai?
options: Paani rok kar rok deti hai
Paani ka raasta moR kar usse alag-alag jagah pahunchati hai
ans: Paani ka raasta moR kar usse alag-alag jagah pahunchati hai
explanation: Water diversion = paani ka raasta moR kar alag-alag jagahon tak pahunchana — jaise Kallanai Kaveri ke paani ko delta mein baanta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Diversion ka seedha sa arth: jo paani samundar barbaad ho kar jaata, use kheton tak le jaana! Aaj ke barrages-canal systems isi idea ke luxe versions hain. Ganga-canal, Indira Gandhi canal — sabka puraaja Kallanai hai. Paani jahan aap le jaao, wahin fal milega — yahi hydrology ka funda hai!

text: Kallanai ko samay ke saath kya karna padaa?
ans: Kai baar restore karna padaa
explanation: Samay ke saath Kallanai kai baar restore kiya gaya — aur aaj bhi kaam kar raha hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Restore karna = theek kar ke wapas chalu karna, dobara banana nahi! Structure original hi hai, sirf patch-work hua hai. 2000 saal mein baarish, baadh, yudh — sab kuch jhela gaya. Restoration culture ki nishaani: jab koi cheez kaam ki hoti hai, log use zinda rakhte hain. Kallanai living heritage hai — photo-frame nahi!

text: Karikala ki murti (Fig 6.16) kahan hai?
options: Grand Anicut Memorial Park, Tamil Nadu mein
ans: Grand Anicut Memorial Park, Tamil Nadu mein
explanation: Karikala ki murti Grand Anicut Memorial Park, Tamil Nadu mein hai — usi dam ke paas jo usne banwaya tha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Memorial park = smriti ka sthan, dam ke kaam ke paas. Raja apne hi kaam ke saath yaad rakha jaata hai — yahi asli legacy hai! Fig 6.16 aur 6.17 ek saath dekho: murti aur dam, dono ek kahani ke do pankh. Statue dekh kar socho: kya sirf jang-jit raja hai, ya engineer-raja? History dono jawab deta hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 12 — Cheras — Keralaputra (PDF p.17)
conceptText: Keralaputra (Kerala ke putra) ke naam se bhi jaane jaane wale Cheras ne Tamil Nadu ke paschimi hisson aur Kerala par shasan kiya — unki rajdhani Vanji thi, jo aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein Karur hai. Unhone kshetr ki cultural aur aarthik itihaas ko shape karne mein ehem kaam kiya — Tamil literature ke growth ko badhaya aur Sangam kaviyon ko patronage (aashray) diya. Cheras apne Roman Empire aur West Asia ke saath vyapaar ke vyaapak connections ke liye jaane jaate hain — Bharat se bahar ki duniya tak kai saman export karte the. Unka rajya masale (spices), lakdi (timber), haaathi-daant (ivory) aur moti (pearls) ke export ka hub ban gaya. 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Kya kabhi socha hai — historians do door ke rajyon ke beech ke trade relations kaise pata karte hain? Ek minute roko aur brainstorm karo — yeh information kaise saamne aati hai? Chera rajaon ne apne shaasan mein kai sikke jaari kiye. Neeche diye gaye ek sikke par Cheras ka royal emblem (shahi nishaan) notice karo! 📷 Fig 6.18 — Chera rajaon ke sikke — jis par Cheras ka royal emblem bana hai.

text: Cheras ko kis naam se bhi jaana jaata hai?
ans: Keralaputra (Kerala ke putra)
explanation: Cheras ko Keralaputra — Kerala ke putra — ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Putra ke saath naam — Keralaputra = Kerala ka beta! Ashoka ke edicts mein bhi Keralaputras ka zikr milta hai — yani Cheras ka naam 2300 saal purane records mein hai. Kerala ki identity isi naam se judi hai. Tamil, Malayalam — dono paramparayein is kshetr ki dhaara se nikli hain!

text: Cheras ki rajdhani kya thi aur woh aaj kahan hai?
options: Vanji — aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein Karur
ans: Vanji — aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein Karur
explanation: Chera rajdhani Vanji thi — jo aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein Karur hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Interesting — Kerala ke putra kaha jaane wale Cheras ki rajdhani aaj Tamil Nadu mein hai! Ancient borders aaj ke state lines se alag the — Karur aam aur alluvial ilaqué mein tha, trade routes ka node. Vanji ka naam Sangam kavita mein baar-baar aata hai. Rajya ki pehchaan capital se hoti hai — economic + political centre!

text: Cheras ne kis bhasha-sahitya ko badhawa diya?
options: Tamil literature ke growth ko — Sangam kaviyon ko patronage diya
ans: Tamil literature ke growth ko — Sangam kaviyon ko patronage diya
explanation: Cheras ne Tamil literature ke growth ko badhaya aur Sangam kaviyon ko aashray (patronage) diya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Patronage = kalaakaron ko khana-ghar aur izzat dena, taaki woh kala bana sakein! Kavi bhi pet bhar kar hi likh sakte hain. Chera, Chola, Pandya — teeno Sangam ka patrons the. Isliye Sangam kavita inhi darbaaron ki hawa mein gayi thi. Literature aur political power ka purana rishta: raja kavita banwata hai, kavita raja ko amar kar deti hai!

text: Cheras ke trade connections kahan tak the?
options: Roman Empire aur West Asia tak
ans: Roman Empire aur West Asia tak
explanation: Cheras ke trade connections Roman Empire aur West Asia tak the — duniya ke bahar tak vyaapar ke hub the! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Muziris (Kerala ka prasiddh port — aaj ke Kodungallur ke paas) Roman ships ka favourite theher tha! Roman writers ne India ke masalon ki tarif likhi hai. West Asia (Arab-Iran) ke saath bhi land-sea trade. Chera coast se masale jaate the — itne ki Rome ka sona India ki taraf behta gaya. Spice trade = ancient ki oil!

text: Chera rajya kis cheez ka export hub tha?
options: Masale (spices), lakdi (timber), haaathi-daant (ivory) aur moti (pearls) ka
ans: Masale (spices), lakdi (timber), haaathi-daant (ivory) aur moti (pearls) ka
explanation: Chera rajya spices, timber, ivory aur pearls ke export ka hub tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kerala ka black pepper Roman duniya mein sona jitna mehnga tha — kai baar gold ke barabar ke weight mein diya jaata tha! Lakdi = Kerala ke jungle (teak, sandalwood), ivory = haaathi-daant, pearls = samundar. Yeh sab luxury items the Rome ke ameeron ke liye. Kerala ke pahaad + samundar = natural export package!

text: THINK ABOUT IT: historians do door ke rajyon ke trade relations kaise pata karte hain?
options: Multiple sources se — sikke, abhilekh, doosre deshon ke records, aur archaeological milaap se
ans: Multiple sources se — sikke, abhilekh, doosre deshon ke records, aur archaeological milaap se
explanation: Trade relations ka pata multiple sources se hota hai — sikke (coins), inscriptions, doosre deshon ke likhe records, aur excavation se mile saaman. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Rome mein India ka saaman dikha, India mein Roman sikke mile — dono jodte hain toh trade route saaf dikhayi deta hai! Archaeology = puzzle ke tukde jodna: amphora (Roman bartan) Kerala ke port par mila, Tamil inscriptions mein Yavana traders ka zikr. Ek source se nahi, kai sources ko cross-check karte hain — yahi history ki asli method hai!

text: Chera rajaon ne kya jaari (issue) kiya?
options: Apne naam ke sikke — jin par royal emblem bana tha
ans: Apne naam ke sikke — jin par royal emblem bana tha
explanation: Chera rajaon ne apne shaasan mein kai sikke jaari kiye — jin par unka royal emblem (shahi nishaan) bana tha (Fig 6.18). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sikka ancient ka business-card + bank-note + rajya ki pehchaan! Emblem se pata chalta hai kis vansh ka sikka hai. Cheron ka emblem traditional tae hua — bow and arrow maana jaata hai (kitaab kehta hai notice karo). Sikke chalte hain toh unki empire ka asar bhi chalta hai — trade ke saath sikke doosre deshon tak pahunch kar apni pehchaan phailate the!

text: Chera rajya kis kshetr ko shape karta raha?
options: Kshetr ki cultural aur economic history ko — Tamil literature se Roman trade tak
ans: Kshetr ki cultural aur economic history ko — Tamil literature se Roman trade tak
explanation: Cheras ne kshetr ki cultural aur economic history ko shape kiya — Tamil literature aur trade dono unke shaasan ke under badhe. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Culture + economy = dono ek saath chalte hain! Trade se aayi samriddhi kala-kavita ko paya karti hai. Muziris ka port ameer bana, aur ameer log kavi-on ko dete the. Kerala aaj bhi spice-vyapar aur culture dono ke liye jaana jaata hai — continuity 2000 saal ki! Cheras ki asli virasat yahi combo hai!

text: Cheras Tamil Nadu ke kis hisse par bhi raaj karte the?
options: Tamil Nadu ke paschimi (western) hisson par
ans: Tamil Nadu ke paschimi (western) hisson par
explanation: Cheras ne Tamil Nadu ke paschimi hisson aur Kerala par shasan kiya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paschimi Tamil Nadu + Kerala = Chera ka kshetr. Arabian Sea ke kinare ka patti — port-vyapar ke liye perfect! Poorv ki taraf Chola (Kaveri delta), beech mein Pandya (Madurai). Geography ne teeno ke roles decide kiye: Chera = coast trade, Chola = delta kheti, Pandya = andar ka ilaqua. Ek hi south, teen taag — Sangam politics ka formula!

text: Chera sikke dekh kar hum kya samajh sakte hain?
options: Royal emblem se vansh ki pehchaan, aur trade ke saath unke sikke kahan-kahan pahunche
ans: Royal emblem se vansh ki pehchaan, aur trade ke saath unke sikke kahan-kahan pahunche
explanation: Sikke ke royal emblem se vansh ki pehchaan milti hai — aur unke trade partners ke ilaqon mein sikke ka milna trade relations ka saboot hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Sikka = chalta-phirta proof! Agar Chera sikka Egypt ke port par mile, toh wahan tak trade thi — simple! Numismatics (sikke ka adhyayan) history ki full-time branch hai. Roman gold coins Kerala mein mile hain — isi logic se. Socho: tumhara pocket ka sikka 2000 saal baad kisi ko bataega ki tum kahan se the!

text: Sangam kaviyon ko Chera darbaar mein kya mila?
ans: Patronage — aashray, samman aur bhet (rewards)
explanation: Chera darbaar mein Sangam kaviyon ko patronage — aashray aur samman mila. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Raja-kavi ka rishta win-win tha: kavi ko roti-ghar, raja ko immortality (kavita mein)! Sangam anthologies mein rajaon ki tareef ke padh hain (called praise poems) — yehi us patronage ka byaj tha. Aaj bhi governments art-culture ko fund karti hain — sahitya akademi awards etc. Idea 2000 saal purana hai — culture ko sambhalna rajya ka kaam maana jaata hai!

ruleTitle: PAGE 13 — Pandyas aur Indo-Greeks ki Aamad (PDF p.18)
conceptText: 📌 THINK ABOUT IT Pandyas apne motiyon (pearls) ke liye jaane jaate the. Aapke hisaab se moti in samayon mein vyapaar ka important article kyun the? Pandyas ka shasan Tamil Nadu ke hisson aur aas-paas ke ilaqon par — rajdhani aaj ke Madurai mein — kai saalon BCE tak jaata hai. Baad-baad ke rajaon ne Pandya rajya ko badhaya. Megasthenes ne apni kitaab Indika mein is rajya ko ek samriddh (prosperous) rajya bataya — jo mazboot administration aur door door ki taakaton jaise Greeks aur Romans ke saath active trade wala tha — apart from bahut internal (andaruni) trade. (Kharavela, misal ke taur par, kehta hai ki use Pandyas rajya se laaye sau moti (hundreds of pearls) milte the!) Pandyas subcontinent ki ek important naval shakti (samundri taakat) bhi the. Baad ke Pandyas ne kshetr ki kala, architecture aur overall samriddhi mein bhi bada yogdaan diya. Pandyas ne kai abhilekh chhode jinme unke rajaon ne apni praja ke kalyaan ke liye bade dhyan aur saare schools of thought aur vishwas ke liye prutsaahan (encouragement) ka dava kiya. 📌 Invasions of the Indo-Greeks Ab chalo dakshin ka sair kar ke wapas uttar (north) chalte hain — jahan ek bilkul alag tarah ka development hone wala hai. Ab tak hum sirf kuch swadeshi (native) vansh dekh aaye; par isi daur mein aise invaders bhi aaye jo northwest frontier se daakhil hue aur subcontinent ke uttari-paschimi, uttari aur madhyami ilaqon par control le liya. Pehle Alexander ke Indus ke maidanon mein hue chhote campaign ki virasat ko samajhte hain. Jab woh apne jeete hue ilaqon se laut raha tha, usne apne peeche satraps (governors) chhod diye. Samay ke saath, in regional shasakon ne apne alag-alag independent domein qayam kiye — aur Indo-Greeks kehlaye. Mauryas ke girawat ke baad uttari-paschimi ilaqe (aaj ke Pakistan aur Afghanistan) Indo-Greeks ke liye easy target the. Par jab yeh conquerors ke roop mein aaye, woh desh ki ameer local culture se kaafi asar se bhi prabhavit hue. Is cultural interaction se governance, kala, bhasha aur daily life mein Greek aur Bhartiya elements ka mix paida hua — jisne kshetr ka cultural landscape shape kiya. 📷 Fig 6.19 — Heliodorus pillar, Vidisha (Madhya Pradesh) ke paas — Indo-Greek aur Bhartiya sanskriti ke milne ka saboot. Vidisha (Madhya Pradesh) ke paas Heliodorus pillar aise connections ka ek prasiddh example hai. Yeh ek Indo-Greek raajdoot (ambassador) ke naam par hai — jisne apne abhilekh mein Vasudeva ko god of gods kaha hai! (Is pillar ki poori kahaani agli page par…)

text: Pandyas ki rajdhani kya thi?
ans: Madurai (aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein)
explanation: Pandyas ki rajdhani Madurai thi — aaj ke Tamil Nadu mein. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Madurai = Pandya ka dil! Yeh sheher Sangam literature ka bhi ghar tha (kaviyon ki sabha yahan hoti thi) — aur Silappadikaram ki kahaani ka bhi (Kovalan ko wahan shikast hui thi!). Ek sheher, teen kahaniyan — rajniti, kavita, aur nyay. Aaj bhi Madurai ka Meenakshi mandir India ke sabse prasiddh temples mein hai — continuity 2000+ saal ki!

text: Megasthenes ne Pandyas ke baare mein apni kis kitaab mein likha?
ans: Indika

Usne Pandyas ko prosperous bataya — strong administration + Greeks aur Romans ke saath trade! Do alag-alag source (Greek kitaab + Tamil tradition) ek hi baat kehte hain — historian ke liye gold-standard proof!

text: Pandyas kis cheez ke liye prasiddh the (THINK ABOUT IT wala)?

explanation: Pandyas apne motiyon (pearls) ke liye jaane jaate the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Moti us samay ki luxury item thi — paane (pearl oyster) samundar se nikaal kar kai hazaron ki mehnat se ek moti milta tha. Madurai ke paas (asli me lekin ke paas ke samundar) se moti aate the. Kharavela kehta tha ki use Pandyas se sau moti milte the — pearls asli asli currency thi! Aaj bhi pearls = shaadi aur izzat ka nishaan, us samay bhi aisa hi tha!

Inscription mein trade ka chhota zikr bhi economics ka bada saboot hai — yahi toh history ka mazaa hai, chhoti detail badi kahani banati hai!

Governance, kala, bhasha, daily life — sab mein Greek + Bhartiya mix. Heliodorus pillar isi ka chhota saboot — Greek ambassador Vasudeva ko god of gods kehta hai. ruleTitle: PAGE 14 — Heliodorus Stambh aur Shaka Samvat (PDF p.19)
conceptText: Heliodorus ek Indo-Greek raajdoot (ambassador) tha — jisne Vidisha ke paas apna stambh khada karwaya, jiska abhilekh Vasudeva ko god of gods kehta hai! Abhilekh mein likha hai: Three immortal precepts (footsteps) — jab unka aacharan kiya jaaye toh swarg le jaate hain: self-restraint (sanyam), charity (daan), consciousness (chetna). 📷 Fig 6.20 — Indo-Greek ka chandi ka sikka jis par ek taraf Vasudeva-Krishna bane hain. Uttar Bharat ki khudai (excavations) mein puratatva-vediyon (archaeologists) ko kai Indo-Greek sikke mile hain — jinse humein in shasakon ke baare mein zyadatar jaankari mili hai. Yeh sikke sona, chandi, tamba aur nickel ke the — aksar ek taraf raja aur doosri taraf Greek devi-devta dikhaate the. Par kuch sikke, iske bajaye, Bhartiya devi-devta — jaise Vasudeva-Krishna aur Lakshmi dikhaate the! 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Aapke hisaab se kuch Indo-Greek sikkon par Vasudeva-Krishna ya Lakshmi jaise devi-devta ka hona kya maayene rakhta tha? 📌 DON'T MISS OUT Shakas (kabhi-kabhi Indo-Scythians kaha jaata hai) bhi subcontinent ke uttar-paschim mein dakhil hue aur 2nd century BCE ke latter part se 5th century CE tak shasan kiya. Unke rajya Indo-Greeks ke baad power par aaye, aur Kushanas ke aane tak (neeche dekho) taakat mein rahe. Isi daur mein Shaka Samvat calendar developed hua! Yeh Gregorian calendar se 78 saal peeche hai (January-March se jab 79 saal peeche). Isse 1957 mein Indian National Calendar ke roop mein adopt kiya gaya tha. 📷 Fig 6.21 — Bharat Sarkar ki official publication — jisme dates Gregorian aur Shaka Samvat dono eras mein di gayi hain.

text: Heliodorus kaun tha?

explanation: Heliodorus ek Indo-Greek raajdoot (ambassador) tha — jisne Vidisha ke paas apna stambh khada karwaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Greek naam, Bhartiya kaam! Heliodorus Takshashila ke Greek raja (Antialkidas naam ka maana jaata hai) ka Vidisha ke raja (Bhagabhadra) ke darbaar mein bheja hua ambassador tha. Yehi pillar uska khud ka personal vaishnav bhakti ka nishani bhi hai. Diplomacy + devotion ka rare combo — ek pole par dono! Isliye yeh pillar history ke superstars mein hai!

Yeh cultural assimilation ka pahad jaisa saboot hai — videshi apni aankhen bandh nahi kiye, balki local parampara ko apne sheersh par rakha. 113 BCE ke aas-paas ka maana jaata hai yeh stambh. Bhakti ka antarrashtriya passport — Greeks se lekar aaj tak!

text: Heliodorus ke abhilekh wale teen amar precepts (footsteps) kaunse hain?

ans: Self-restraint (sanyam), charity (daan), consciousness (chetna) — inke aacharan se swarg milta hai
explanation: Teen immortal precepts: self-restraint (sanyam), charity (daan), consciousness (chetna) — inka aacharan karne se swarg milta hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Yeh values kisi ek dharm ki nahi — universal hain! Greek ambassador ne Bhartiya philosophy ke teen values apna liye. Sanyam = khud par control, daan = dena, chetna = jagrut rahna. Teen values, teen dharm — Bhartiya, Greek, Jain sab mein aati hain! Isliye cultural conference ka matlab yahi hai: sab achhi cheezein sabke liye khuli hain!

Kitaben jal gayi, kagaz bikhar gaye — par sikke zameen mein surakshit rahe. Har sikka ek raja ka naam, unka chehra, unke devta sab record karta hai. Isi liye numismatics (coin-study) ki apni alag field hai. Jab likhi history kam ho, sikke bolein — Indo-Greek history isi se bani hai!

Metalurgy + economics + art — teeno ek sikke mein. Indo-Greeks ki engineering bhi kamaal ki thi!

Greek raja Greek gods ke saath apna brand banata hai — Zeus, Apollo sab sikke par aate the. Par kuch sikke par Vasudeva-Krishna aur Lakshmi bani! Yeh switch kya batata hai? Raja apni local audience ko impress karna chahta tha — politics + culture dono sikke se chalte the!

Yeh LET'S EXPLORE ka jawab hai: local logon ka bharosa jeetne ke liye raja unke devtaon ko apnaata tha. Yeh bhi cultural confluence ka strategy hai — diplomacy through devotion! Aaj bhi desh ke leader alag-alag bhasha mein baat karte hain — same logic, 2200 saal purana!

Bas jan-march mein ek saal ka farak aa jaata hai kyunki shaka new year Gregorian se pehle aata hai. Yeh calculation-based sawaal exam mein zaroor aata hai. Trick: 78 ka constant yaad rakho, march ke pehle 79!

Desh azaad hua toh apna national calendar chahiye tha — Gregorian nahi, Islamic nahi — toh ancient Indian shaka chuna gaya. National identity ke liye history se cheez uthana common hai. Duniya mein har desh ka apna calendar-erah hota hai!

explanation: Indo-Greeks ka shaasan Shakas (Indo-Scythians) ke invasions ke saath khatam hua. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: History ka cycle: pehle Indo-Greeks aaye, phir unhe Shakas ne hata diya, phir Kushanas ne Shakaon ko! Northwest ka ghar-ka-gharaasar lagatar chalta raha. Har naya aane wala pehle wale ka ghar saaf karta tha — par culture aage badhti rahi. Kitaab ka line: Indo-Greeks ka ant Shaka invasions se hua — yeh sequence yaad rakho: Indo-Greek → Shaka → Kushana!

ruleTitle: PAGE 15 — Kushanas aur Kanishka (PDF p.20)
conceptText: Kushanas, originally Central Asia se the — Bharat mein shayad 2nd century CE mein daakhil hue. Apne peak par unka samrajya Central Asia se lekar uttari Bharat ke bade hisson tak phaala tha. Unke shaasan ka daur extensive cultural intermixing ka tha aur Bhartiya subcontinent ki itihaas par gehra asar dal gaya. Jab woh apne military campaigns se fursat mein hote, toh Kanishka art aur culture ko encourage karta — jis se naye artistic styles ke development hue. 📷 Fig 6.22 — Raja Kanishka ki headless (bina sir wali) murti — 1.85 m unchi — probably Kushana vansh ka sabse takatvar shasak. 📷 Fig 6.23 — Kanishka ke sikke — pehle sikke par Kanishka bana hai (ne third coin par Buddha ke saath). Kaun hai sikke par emperor ke alawa? 📷 Fig 6.23 — Kanishka ke sikke — doosre sikke par doosri taraf Shiva aur bail Nandi (agle page par poori baat!). 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Yeh massive (1.85 m unchi) murti dhyan se dekho — kapde, hathiyar (weapon) aur footwear (juatan) notice karo. Yeh is figure ke baare mein kya batata hai? 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Sikko ko dhyan se dekho — kaun, emperor ke alawa, sikke par dikhta hai? Yeh prasiddh headless murti Raja Kanishka ki hai — shayad Kushana vansh ka sabse takatvar shasak. Murti par Brahmi abhilekh likha hai: maharaja rajadhiraja devaputra kanishka — yani The great king, king of kings, son of God, Kanishka!

explanation: Kushanas originally Central Asia se the aur Bharat mein shayad 2nd century CE mein daakhil hue. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Central Asia = aaj ke Uzbekistan-Tajikistan wala ilaqua — Silk Route ka beech ka hissa! Kushanas nomadic-shakti se empire banane ka classic example hain. 2nd century CE matlab Maurya se ~500 saal baad, aur Satavahana ke ant se bhi baad. Sequence yaad rakho: Indo-Greek → Shaka → Kushana. Central Asia mein Balkh-Takshashila (Silk Route ke bade sheher) unke under the, aur India mein Mathura-Pataliputra tak (aage dekhoge). Empire jitna bada, utna hi trade-culture ka network. Silk Route par control ka matlab — Asia ke vyapaar ka bada hissa aapke haath! Isi se prosperity aayi jisse art phoola!

explanation: Kushana shaasan ka daur extensive cultural intermixing ka tha — subcontinent ki itihaas par gehra asar pada! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Central Asia + India + Greece-Rome ke art influences — sab Kanishka ke under ek platform par mile! Gandhara aur Mathura dono art schools isi daur mein phoole. Buddhist art ne bhi is daur mein badi chhalaang li (Buddha ki pehli murtiyan aisi manni jaati hain). Multi-culture empire ka fayda: sabka best mil kar naya banta hai!

text: Kanishka military campaigns ke beech mein kya karta tha?

explanation: Jab military campaigns se fursat milti, toh Kanishka art aur culture ko encourage karta — isse naye artistic styles develop hue. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Soldier + art-collector! Kanishka jaise conquerors ne kala ko sponsorship di — kyunki samrajya ko sirf talwar nahi, tarakki se bhi chalana hota hai. Ashoka ne yudh chhod kar dham chuna, Kanishka dono karta raha — yudh bhi, kala bhi. Isliye uske daur mein Buddhism bhi phoola (Mahayana school ka bada patron) aur Gandhara art bhi bana!

explanation: Kanishka ki murti headless hai — 1.85 m unchi massive stone statue (sir baad mein gir gaya/gayab ho gaya). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: 1.85 m = ek lamba aadmi jitna! text: Kanishka ki murti ka Brahmi abhilekh kya kehta hai?

explanation: Abhilekh kehta hai — maharaja rajadhiraja devaputra kanishka — yani The great king, king of kings, son of God, Kanishka. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Teen-shabd wali title-chaain! Maharaja (great king) + rajadhiraja (kings ka raja) + devaputra (devta ka putra). Devaputra title Central Asian/Chinese style se aaya (Chinese emperors ka son of heaven concept). Kushanas ne Bharat mein apna Central Asian style + Indian grandeur joda. Title = political branding — jitne bade shabd, utna bada rajya dikhta hai!

text: Devaputra ka kya matlab hai?

explanation: Devaputra = God ka putra (son of God) — raja apne aap ko divya darshane ke liye use karta tha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Raja ko devta ka beta keh kar power ko divine stamp milta tha — log kaise karenge challenge? Yeh idea China ke emperors (Son of Heaven) aur Rome ke Caesars (divi filius) mein bhi tha! Kushanas ne ise apna liya. Aaj bhi kai deshon mein monarchy ko divine link dene ki koshish hoti thi. History mein power ka legitimisation ka naya formula: naam mein devta jod do!

ruleTitle: PAGE 17 — Silk Route — Vishwa ke Vyapar Marg (PDF p.22-23)
conceptText: 📷 Fig 6.25 — Prachin duniya ke kuch trade routes. Green network Silk Route hai — jo China se Mediterranean duniya ko jodta hua central Asia, Persia aadi se hokar guzarta hai. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Map ka western hissa — Byzantium, Antioch, Alexandria, Rome — Mediterranean duniya ke bade sheher. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Map ka eastern hissa — India aur China, aur unhe jodne wale marg. 📷 Fig 6.25 — EGYPT, ARABIA, PERSIA — map ke madhya ke ilaqué jinke aar-paar se trade routes guzarti hain. 📷 Fig 6.25 — ARABIA ke ilaqué ke routes — caravan-marg jo registanon ko paar karte hain. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Qumis (Iran), Balkh, Samarkand — central Asia ke bade trade sheher, SCYTHIA ilaqué mein. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Luoyang — China ka bada sheher jahan se Silk Route shuru hokar west ki taraf jaata tha. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Damascus aur SCYTHIA — map ke kinaare ke ilaqué aur unke naam. 📷 Fig 6.25 — Mathura, Pataliputra, Takshashila, Tamralipti — India ke wahi sheher jinse trade routes guzarte the. Yeh double-page naksha dikhata hai ki prachin duniya kaise ek doosre se judi hui thi — China se lekar Rome (Mediterranean) tak — aur beech mein central Asia ke sheher (Samarkand, Balkh), Persia, Arabia aur Egypt. Silk Route ka naam China ke resham (silk) se pada — jo is raste se duniya tak jaata tha. India ke andar ke sheher — Mathura, Pataliputra, Takshashila aur Tamralipti — bhi in routes se jude the. Kushanas ka Silk Route par control hone ka matlab tha ki har caravan ke through ka maal aur toll dono unke haath mein the!

Isi khaas maal ke naam par poora network Silk Route kehlaya. Naam interesting hai: German historian Ferdinand von Richthofen ne 1877 mein yeh naam diya tha. Par rasta hazaron saal se chal raha tha. Isliye yeh maal gold-jaisa gehra jaata tha. Rome ke ameer log aur senators China ke silk mein pade rehte the. Ek jarriwi (silk worm) ne duniya ki geography badal di — trade ka asli boss demand hai!

Trade route = internet ki tarah tha — data (ideas) aur files (goods) dono transfer hote the. Isi liye historians kehte hain ki civilisations akele nahi badhti — contact se badhti hain! ruleTitle: PAGE 18 — Mathura Shaili aur Sanskrit Sahitya (PDF p.24)
conceptText: 📷 Fig 6.26 — Kubera — dhan ke devta — Mathura School of Art se. Kya aapne uski prominent mooch (moustache) notice ki? Mooch kuch Indian sculptures ki khaas pehchaan hai! Mathura shaili aaj ke Uttar Pradesh ke Mathura kshetr mein develop hui aur apne alag, swadeshi (distinct Indian) style ke liye jaani jaati hai. Gandhara shaili ke ulata, yeh apni sculptures ke liye mukhya taur par lal balua patthar (red sandstone) use karti hai aur Greco-Roman aesthetics ka kam asar dikhati hai. Is art form mein Bhartiya devi-devta — Kubera, Lakshmi, Shiva, Buddha, yakshas aur yakshinis ke chitre hain — aur aam taur par bhare-bhare (fuller) shareer aur smooth (chikni) modelling ke saath banti hain. 📌 LET'S EXPLORE Ab jab aap Mathura aur Gandhara styles ki basic baatein jaante ho, Fig 6.27 (agle page) ki artefact pictures ko dekho aur har ek artefact kis school ka hai pehchane ki koshish karo. Apne observations with justifications likho aur classmates ke saath discuss karo! Rajneetik conflicts aur power-struggles ke bawajood, is daur mein cultural exchange aur assimilation ka chamatkar hua. Yeh shared heritage art aur architecture mein dikhti hai — jahan styles aapas mein interact karte the, par Bhartiya themes (khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist) ka dominance raha. Yeh woh daur bhi tha jab Sanskrit sahitya phoola — khaas kar Mahabharata aur Ramayana jaise bade Bhartiya granthon ki rachna (refer karo apni Grade 6 kitaab ka chapter Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One). In connections ko pehchaan kar hum is Tapestry of the Past ko kisi ek rajya ya raja tak simit nahi dekhte — balki ek dynamic process ke roop mein dekhte hain jo interaction aur assimilation ke through samay ke saath chalta hai.

text: Mathura shaili kahan develop hui?
options: Aaj ke Uttar Pradesh ke Mathura kshetr mein
ans: Aaj ke Uttar Pradesh ke Mathura kshetr mein
explanation: Mathura shaili aaj ke UP ke Mathura kshetr mein develop hui — apne distinct Indian style ke liye jaani jaati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mathura = Krishna ki janm-bhoomi, aur bhi ek khaas cheez — art ka swadeshi factory! Yahan red sandstone milta tha local, aur local shilpi apne Indian style mein kaam karte the. Gandhara Greek touch ke saath, Mathura pure Indian andaaz. Ek hi samrajya (Kushana) mein do alag styles — competition se dono behtar! Isliye India ka art map itna rangeen hai!

text: Mathura shaili mukhya taur par kis patthar se sculptures banati hai?
ans: Lal balua patthar (red sandstone)
explanation: Mathura shaili mukhya taur par red sandstone (lal balua patthar) se sculptures banati hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Patthar = art school ka ID card! Gandhara = grey-black schist, Mathura = red sandstone. UP-Mathura kshetr mein lal patthar aasaani se milta tha (Agra ke Fatehpur Sikri isi se bana hai!). Lal patthar naram hota hai — smooth, bhare shareer wali murtiyan aasaani se banti hain. Exam mein patthar ka rang pooch hi lete hain — Gandhara vs Mathura, bas itni si pehchaan!

text: Mathura art Greco-Roman aesthetics se kaise judi hai?
options: Kam asar dikhati hai — Gandhara ke ulata, yeh distinct Indian style hai
ans: Kam asar dikhati hai — Gandhara ke ulata, yeh distinct Indian style hai
explanation: Mathura shaili Greco-Roman aesthetics ka kam asar dikhati hai — Gandhara ke ulata — yeh distinct Indian style hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi empire mein do schools — ek Greek fusion (Gandhara), ek swadeshi (Mathura)! Mathura ke Buddha aur devta Indian shareer-gunanon mein hain — mote, gol chehra, dharmic mudraen. Gandhara wale Greek-statue jaise patle aur realistic. Dono andar hi India mein the — proof ki swadeshi usool bhi poori taakat se khade the. Diversity in art — India ka permanent theme!

text: Mathura art form mein kaun-kaun se devi-devta aur figures bante hain?
options: Kubera, Lakshmi, Shiva, Buddha, yakshas aur yakshinis
ans: Kubera, Lakshmi, Shiva, Buddha, yakshas aur yakshinis
explanation: Mathura art mein — Kubera, Lakshmi, Shiva, Buddha, yakshas aur yakshinis — kai Bhartiya devi-devta bante the. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi school mein Hindu devi-devta + Buddha + folk deities (yaksha-yakshini) — sab! Yeh chapter ka co-existence theme phir aata hai. Kubera (dhan ka devta) ki murti Fig 6.26 mein dekhi — Mathura style ka example. Mathura mein Jain tirthankar bhi bane the. Art school ek, vishay anant — India ka fusion formula!

text: Mathura sculptures ke shareer ka style kaisa hota hai?
ans: Bhare-bhare (fuller) shareer aur smooth (chikni) modelling
explanation: Mathura sculptures aam taur par fuller (bhare hue) shareer aur smooth modelling ke saath banti hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fuller figure = bhara hua, gol-matol shareer — Indian kala mein ise shubh maana jaata hai (prosperity ka symbol)! Smooth modelling = patthar par aisa lagta hai jaise mom (wax) ki tarah glides ho rahi ho. Gandhara ke figures athletik-patle, Mathura ke sukoon-bhare. Body type se hi school pehchaan lo — exam observation ka favourite sawaal hai!

text: Fig 6.26 ki Kubera murti mein kya khaas feature hai (jo kitaab ne point-out kiya)?
options: Uski prominent mooch (moustache) — kuch Indian sculptures ki khaas pehchaan
ans: Uski prominent mooch (moustache) — kuch Indian sculptures ki khaas pehchaan
explanation: Kubera ki murti mein prominent mooch (moustache) hai — yeh kuch Indian sculptures ki distinguishing feature hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mooch = ancient India ka style statement! Kubera (dhan ka devta) mooch aur lambi kaan wale robust figure ke roop mein. Central Asian art mein bhi mooch ka style tha — Mathura ne apne version mein adapt kiya. Aaj bhi moustache in Indian culture mein dignity ka symbol hai. Detail matter karti hai — ek mooch se art-history ki pehchaan ho jaati hai!

text: Is daur mein Sanskrit sahitya ka kya hua?
options: Phoole-phala — Mahabharata aur Ramayana jaise bade granthon ki rachna is daur mein hui
ans: Phoole-phala — Mahabharata aur Ramayana jaise bade granthon ki rachna is daur mein hui
explanation: Is daur mein Sanskrit sahitya phoole-phala — Mahabharata aur Ramayana jaise bade Bhartiya granthon ki rachna hui. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Mahabharata-Ramayana ke final roop (compilation) is daur mein hote maane jaate hain! Sanskrit pehle Pushyamitra (Shunga) ke time se phail rahi thi, aur Kushana-Gupta ke time par classicism ka peak. Kitaab Grade 6 ke chapter Unity in Diversity, or Many in the One ki taraf ishaara karti hai — wahan bhi yeh kaha gaya tha ki epics isi daur mein shape hue. Rajniti tootti, par sahitya juda — culture ka anti-fragile hone isi ko kehte hain!

text: LET'S EXPLORE (Fig 6.27) humse kya karna chahta hai?
options: Mathura aur Gandhara styles ki pehchaan kar ke har artefact ko sahi school se jodna — justification ke saath
ans: Mathura aur Gandhara styles ki pehchaan kar ke har artefact ko sahi school se jodna — justification ke saath
explanation: Fig 6.27 ke artefacts dekh kar har ek kis school (Mathura/Gandhara) ka hai pehchana — observations aur justifications ke saath, phir class discussion! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Art detective bano! Clues kya hain: patthar ka rang (lal = Mathura, grey-black = Gandhara), body style (full = Mathura, realistic = Gandhara), kapde (flowing robes = Gandhara). Yeh exercise observation + reasoning dono banata hai — historian ki asli skill! Agle page par 6 artefacts hain — quiz khud se khelo: yeh Mathura hai ya Gandhara? Answer justify karo — sirf guess nahi!

text: Kitaab ke anusaar is daur ke art-architecture mein kaunsa dominance raha?
options: Bhartiya themes ka — khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist themes ka dominance
ans: Bhartiya themes ka — khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist themes ka dominance
explanation: Styles interact karte rahe par Bhartiya themes (khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist) ka dominance raha! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fusion mein bhi apna rang chhota nahi hota — yeh is chapter ka golden line hai! Greek technique aa sakti hai, par content Bhartiya (Buddha, Shiva, Lakshmi). Aaj bhi global brands India mein Indianized hote hain (pizza mein paneer tikka!). Cultural exchange mein do taraf se lena hota hai, par har culture apna core rakhti hai. India ne Greek loya, par khud India hi rahi — yahi assimilation ki taakat hai!

text: Tapestry of the Past ko ek dynamic process ke roop mein kaise dekhna chahiye?
options: Ek raja ki achievement ke roop mein
Interaction aur assimilation ke through samay ke saath chalta hua ek process
Ek hi samay ki ghatna ke roop mein
Sirf ek naksha ke roop mein
ans: Interaction aur assimilation ke through samay ke saath chalta hua ek process
explanation: Tapestry = kisi ek rajya/raja tak simit nahi — interaction aur assimilation ke through samay ke saath chalta ek dynamic process. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Tapestry matlab buna hua kapda — jisme har dhaaga ek alag rang, par sab milkar ek design. Ek dhaaga kaat do toh bhi design bacha rehta hai! Isi liye chapter ka naam Tapestry of the Past hai — history kisi ek raja ki daastaan nahi, sabki mil-juli kahani hai. Interaction (milna) + assimilation (assimilate hona) = India ki asli tarakki ka formula. Chapter khatam, concept zinda rehta hai!

text: Cultural assimilation ka kya matlab hai?
options: Doosri cheezon ko apane andar apana lena — milkar naya ban jaana
ans: Doosri cheezon ko apane andar apana lena — milkar naya ban jaana
explanation: Assimilation = doosri culture ke elements ko apna kar lena — jaise khaana pachana — taaki naya, aur bhi samriddh roop bane. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Pachana (digestion) best metaphor hai! Indo-Greeks aaye, Bhartiya bane; Shaka aaye, Bhartiya bane — par sabke apne gun bhi Indian culture ne apna liye (coinage, calendar, art). India koi khali kamra nahi — ek chalti hui nadi hai jisme har nadi ka paani milta hai, par behti apni hi dhaara hai. Chapter ka sabse bada sabak: assimilation, na ki elimination!

ruleTitle: PAGE 19 — Kushana Yug ke Shilp — Fig 6.27 (PDF p.25)
conceptText: Yeh kai artefacts Kushana daur se hain — kuch Gandhara school se, kuch Mathura school se. DON'T MISS ki patthar, shareer aur kapdon ke farak se pehchaano — kaunsa kis school ka hai! 📷 Fig 6.27.1 — Buddha ki mrityu (parinirvana) ka drishya — shishya giriye hue Buddha ke aas-paas. 📷 Fig 6.27.2 — Bodhisattva Maitreya — bhavishya ke Buddha. 📷 Fig 6.27.3 — Shiva linga jise Kushana bhakt pooch rahe hain — devi-devta ki puja ka roop bhi isi daur mein bada. 📷 Fig 6.27.4 — Do Nagis ke beech ek Naga — is par abhilekh Kanishka ke shaasan ka 8va saal ka zikr karta hai! 📷 Fig 6.27.5 — Kartikeya (yudh ke devta) aur Agni (aag ke devta) . 📷 Fig 6.27.6 — Khade hue Buddha — dharmic mudra ke saath. In artefacts mein Buddhist aur Hindu dono themes ek saath hain — parinirvana, bodhisattva, Shiva linga, Naga, Kartikeya, Agni — yeh is daur ke multi-religious art ka sabse saaf drishya hai. Naga-Nagi ki carving par likha abhilekh Kanishka ke 8ve regnal saal ka zikr karta hai — jisse humein date mil jaati hai!

text: Fig 6.27.1 ka drishya kya dikhata hai?
options: Buddha ki mrityu (parinirvana) — shishya aas-paas giriye hue
ans: Buddha ki mrityu (parinirvana) — shishya aas-paas giriye hue
explanation: Fig 6.27.1 Buddha ki mrityu (death of Buddha) ka drishya hai — shishya giriye hue Buddha ke aas-paas hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Parinirvana = Buddha ka antim sansaar se njaara. Is drishye mein Buddha leta hua hai aur aas-paas dukhi shishye. Is theme par kai badi, sundar carvings bani (aaj bhi museums mein hain). Gandhara school ne parinirvana ke emotional scenes master kiye — patthar mein ghamand aur dukh dono tarashe! Art ke through emotions convey karna — ancient India ka cinema tha yeh!

text: Bodhisattva Maitreya kaun hain (Fig 6.27.2)?
options: Bhavishya ke Buddha — jinke aane ka intezaar hai
ans: Bhavishya ke Buddha — jinke aane ka intezaar hai
explanation: Maitreya ek bodhisattva hain — bhavishya (future) ke Buddha jinke aane ka maana jaata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Bodhisattva = woh jise Buddha ban sakta hai, par wo pehle sab jeevon ki madad ka vaada karta hai. Maitreya = is daur ke baad ka Buddha (aane wala). Socho — 2000 saal pehle log future ki planning kar rahe the! Mahayana Buddhism mein bodhisattva ka concept bada important hai. Gandhara art mein Maitreya ki kai murtiyan mili hain — crown aur scarf ke saath — jaise ek raja-prince!

text: Fig 6.27.3 kya dikhata hai?
options: Shiva linga jise Kushana bhakt pooch (worship) rahe hain
ans: Shiva linga jise Kushana bhakt pooch (worship) rahe hain
explanation: Fig 6.27.3 mein Shiva linga hai — jise Kushana bhakt worship kar rahe hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Linga-puja ka itna purana chitra milna bada rare hai! Isse pata chalta hai ki Shaiva parampara Kushana daur mein full-swing mein thi. Kanishka ke sikke par Shiva-Nandi bhi the (pehle page dekha!). Bhakti ke roop — murti, linga, temple — yeh sabhi isi daur ke around develop hue the. Fig 6.27.3 ek living document hai: log kaise poojte the, 2000 saal pehle!

text: Fig 6.27.4 ka Naga-Nagi carving kya hai aur kya khaas hai?
options: Ek nadi ka naksha — koi abhilekh nahi
Do Nagis ke beech ek Naga (sarpanch wale devta) — abhilekh Kanishka ke shaasan ka 8va saal batata hai
Ek raja ki murti — bina abhilekh
ans: Do Nagis ke beech ek Naga (sarpanch wale devta) — abhilekh Kanishka ke shaasan ka 8va saal batata hai
explanation: Fig 6.27.4 — do Nagis ke beech Naga — is par abhilekh Kanishka ke shaasan ka 8va saal (eighth year) ka zikr karta hai! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Naga = sarpanch (snake) devta — paani aur zameen se jude folk deities! Nagi = naari (female) versions. Inki carving Mathura style mein badi common thi. Aur asli hero: abhilekh mein date! Regnal year = raja ke shaasan ka kaun sa saal. Is se historians ko mil gaya anchor-date — 8th year of Kanishka. Art + inscription = history ka perfect jodi (biryani + raita jaisa)!

text: Fig 6.27.5 mein kaun-kaun se devta hain?
options: Kartikeya (yudh ke devta) aur Agni (aag ke devta)
ans: Kartikeya (yudh ke devta) aur Agni (aag ke devta)
explanation: Fig 6.27.5 mein Kartikeya — yudh (war) ke devta — aur Agni — aag (fire) ke devta hain. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Kartikeya = Shiva-Parvati ke putra, sena ke commander (Skanda bhi kehte hain — south mein Murugan). Agni = Vedon ke aag ka devta (havan ka mukhya devta). Ek carving mein do devta — war aur fire — dono takat ke prateek! Mathura school mein aise multi-devta panels common the. Har devta ka apna kaam — ancient India ka cabinet of ministers!

text: Fig 6.27.6 kya dikhata hai?
options: Khade hue Buddha — dharmic mudra ke saath
ans: Khade hue Buddha — dharmic mudra ke saath
explanation: Fig 6.27.6 mein khade hue Buddha hain — dharmic mudra (hath ka chinh) ke saath. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Standing Buddha = Kushana art ka signature pose! Lambe, robe mein, ek haath utha kar (abhaya mudra — dar mat). Isi daur mein Buddha ki murti-bana-puja ka daur shuru hua — pehle sirf chinh the (pad, chakra, bodhi-vriksh). Ab Buddha ek style-icon ban gaye — jisse aam log apne dil se jod sake. Fig 6.27 ke 6 mein se 3 (1, 2, 6) Buddha/Bodhisattva-themed — Kushana art ka favourite subject saaf dikh raha hai!

text: Naga aur Nagi kaun hain?
options: Sarpanch (snake) se jude devta — Naga mard aur Nagi aurat
ans: Sarpanch (snake) se jude devta — Naga mard aur Nagi aurat
explanation: Naga = sarpanch se juda devta (aam taur par mard), Nagi = aurat roop — dono paani aur zameen se jude folk deities. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Naga-puja India ki sabse purani paramparon mein hai — kheti aur paani dono sarpanch ke haath (kisan ka dost!). Isliye Naga devta ko doodh-chaawal chadhate hain, nag-panchami manate hain (aaj bhi!). Mathura art mein Naga hamesha phan (hood) ke saath dikhata hai. Fig 6.27.4 mein ek Naga ke dono taraf Nagi — tritiya-jodi (threesome) panel. Folk religion + classical art ka milna — India ka special combo!

text: Fig 6.27 ke artefacts kis daur se hain (abhilekh ke anusaar)?
options: Kushana daur se — Naga carving Kanishka ke 8ve saal ki hai
ans: Kushana daur se — Naga carving Kanishka ke 8ve saal ki hai
explanation: Yeh artefacts Kushana daur ke hain — Naga-Nagi carving ka abhilekh Kanishka ke shaasan ka 8va saal batata hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Regnal year se dating = history ka Google Calendar! Agar pata hai Kanishka kab takatvar hua (shayad 78 CE se — Shaka era se bhi joda jaata hai!), toh 8th year se date nikaal sakte ho. Isliye inscriptions wale artefacts zyada keemti hote hain — wo sirf sundar nahi, dated bhi hain! Art history ka formula: jismein date ho, wahi superstar artifact hai!

text: Fig 6.27 mein kaun-kaun se religious themes hain (sab milkar)?
options: Buddhist (parinirvana, Maitreya, Buddha) + Hindu (Shiva linga, Kartikeya, Agni) + folk (Naga-Nagi) — sab ek saath
ans: Buddhist (parinirvana, Maitreya, Buddha) + Hindu (Shiva linga, Kartikeya, Agni) + folk (Naga-Nagi) — sab ek saath
explanation: Sab milakar — Buddhist + Hindu + folk (Naga) themes ek hi collection mein — Kushana daur ke multi-religious art ka drishya! 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Ek hi page par Buddha bhi, Shiva bhi, Naga bhi! Yeh tolerance-in-action ka art-gallery version hai. Kushanas ne sabhi dharmon ko apnaaya — isi liye unka empire cultural golden-age maana jaata hai. India ki khaas pehchaan isi se hai — multiple faiths ek shared cultural space mein. Fig 6.27 ek mini-India hai — patthar mein!

text: Kushana art ka religious art ke future par kya asar pada?
options: Buddha-devi-devta ki murti-bana-puja ne baad ke temple architecture ki buniyad rakhi
ans: Buddha-devi-devta ki murti-bana-puja ne baad ke temple architecture ki buniyad rakhi
explanation: Is daur mein murti-bana-puja ne baad ke temple architecture ki buniyad rakhi — devi-devta ke human-like representations ne religious art ko naya roop diya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Chinh (symbol) → murti (statue) → mandir (temple) — yeh progression isi daur mein tez hua! Jab devta insaan jaise dikhne lage, toh unke liye ghar (mandir) banane ka idea bhi aaya. Agle kai saalon mein India bhar mein grand temples bane (Gupta kaal mein peak). Fig 6.27 ke patthar us bade future ke seed the — 2000 saal purane roots, aaj bhi zinda!

ruleTitle: PAGE 20 — Before We Move On — Summary aur Sawaal (PDF p.26-28)
conceptText: • Maurya samrajya ke vighatan (disintegration) ke baad ka daur poore subcontinent mein kai bade-chhote rajyon ke ubharne se markhot tha. • Andaruni conflicts ke saath videshi invasions bhi jude — dono ne milkar political powers ke punar-sangathan (reorganisation) ka daur banaya. • Is daur mein kai cultures ka dialog hua — jinhone ek doosre ka asar lekar art, architecture, coinage ke naye style banaye — jisme ant me Bhartiya themes ka dominance aur Sanskrit sahitya ka phoolna raha. • Yeh samay trade activities — andaruni aur bahari dono mein bhi shaandar developments ka gawah hai. Timeline (Fig 6.28) ke hisaab se mukhya log: Pushyamitra Shunga, Kharavela, Karikala, Gautamiputra Satakarni aur Kanishka — aur vansh: Indo-Greeks, Shungas, Shungas ke saath Satavahanas, Cholas-Cheras-Pandyas, Shakas, Kushanas — 200 BCE se 300 CE tak ke span mein (185 BCE Maurya ka ant, aur CE 100/200/300 ke marks ke saath). 📌 Questions and Activities (Revision) • Post-Maurya yug ko era of reorganisation kyun kaha jaata hai? • Sangam literature par 150 shabdon mein note likho. • Is chapter mein kaun-kaunse shasakon ne apni maa ka naam apne title mein rakha, aur kyun? • Is chapter ke kisi ek rajya ke baare mein 250 shabdon ka note likho jo aapko interesting lage — kyun chuna usne. • Maan lo aapko apna khud ka rajya banane ka mauka mila. Aap kaisa royal emblem chunenge aur kyun? Aap kya title rakhoge? Apne rajya ki values, rules, aur khaas baatein likho. • Post-Maurya yug ke architectural developments padh kar — Bharat ke naksha par is chapter ke kuch prachin structures ki approximate locations mark karo.

text: Maurya ke vighatan ke baad ke daur ki khaas pehchaan kya thi?
options: Poore subcontinent mein kai bade-chhote rajya ubhre
ans: Poore subcontinent mein kai bade-chhote rajya ubhre
explanation: Maurya ke vighatan ke baad poore subcontinent mein kai bade-chhote rajya ubhre — yahi daur ki pehchaan thi. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Vighatan matlab tootna. Par history mein tootna ant nahi hota — naye chapter ka shuru hota hai! Shungas, Satavahanas, Chedis, Cheras-Cholas-Pandyas, Indo-Greeks, Shakas, Kushanas — sab isi toot ke baad uthe. Chapter ka poora drama isi se shuru hota hai: ek chhatri thi (Maurya), ab kai chhatriyan — har ek apni kahani ke saath!

text: Reorganisation ka daur kis combination se bana?
options: Andaruni conflicts + videshi invasions — dono ne milkar political reorganisation banaya
ans: Andaruni conflicts + videshi invasions — dono ne milkar political reorganisation banaya
explanation: Andaruni conflicts + videshi invasions — dono ke combination ne political powers ke punar-sangathan ka daur banaya. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Do forces, ek result: andar se raja lade (Shunga vs Satavahana), bahar se naye aaye (Indo-Greek, Shaka, Kushana). Bilkul tiffin-box jaisa — andar ka khana aur bahar ka masala, dono se naya swaad! Political map baar-baar reshape hua. Isliye reorganisation — kyunki na purana bacha, na ek hi naya bana — kai naye bane!

text: Is daur ke cultural result mein kya dominance raha?
options: Bhartiya themes ka — khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist — aur Sanskrit sahitya ka phoolna
ans: Bhartiya themes ka — khaas kar Hindu aur Buddhist — aur Sanskrit sahitya ka phoolna
explanation: Naye styles bane (art, architecture, coinage) — par ant me Bhartiya themes ka dominance aur Sanskrit sahitya ka phoolna raha. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Fusion ka rule: technique udhaar le sakte ho, par apna swaad apna hi rehta hai! Greek chisel, Indian vishay — Gandhara bani; phir bhi Indian themes dominant rahe. Sanskrit mein Mahabharata-Ramayana jaise maha-granth ishi daur ke. Cultural confidence ka asli proof: sab kuch absorb karo, par core apna rakho. Yeh India ka superpower hai — 2000 saal se continuous!

text: Is daur mein trade ka kya haal tha?
options: Andaruni aur bahari (internal + external) dono mein shaandar developments hue
ans: Andaruni aur bahari (internal + external) dono mein shaandar developments hue
explanation: Yeh daur trade activities — andaruni aur bahari dono mein shaandar developments ka gawah hai. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Trade = is chapter ka chhupa-hua hero! Satavahanas ka Rome-vyaapar, Cheras ka Muziris port, Kushanas ka Silk Route control, Pandyas ke moti — sab trade ke kisse hain. Jab trade chalta hai, toh kala, bhasha aur dharm sab travel karte hain. Isi liye Bharat ke bahar Buddhism aur Indian art ka asar milta hai. Samrajyon ki asli taakat: unke trade routes!

text: Timeline (Fig 6.28) mein kaun-kaun mukhya log hain?
options: Pushyamitra Shunga, Kharavela, Karikala, Gautamiputra Satakarni aur Kanishka
ans: Pushyamitra Shunga, Kharavela, Karikala, Gautamiputra Satakarni aur Kanishka
explanation: Timeline ke mukhya log: Pushyamitra Shunga, Kharavela, Karikala, Gautamiputra Satakarni aur Kanishka. 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Paanch naam, paanch rajya, ek timeline! Har naam apne vansh ka star hai. Timeline banana (LET'S EXPLORE wali activity) yaad hai? In paanch logon ko 200 BCE se 300 CE ke beech place karna — yahi is chapter ka revision hai. Trick: Pushyamitra (185 BCE, shuru) → Kanishka (100 CE ke baad, end ke paas). Naam yaad karo, dates unke aas-paas aa jayengi!

text: Revision question 3 ke anusaar kis raja ne maa ka naam title mein rakha?
options: Gautamiputra Satakarni ne — Satavahana parampara mein maa ke naam se
ans: Gautamiputra Satakarni ne — Satavahana parampara mein maa ke naam se
explanation: Gautamiputra Satakarni — Satavahana parampara mein raja aksar maa ke naam ke saath naam rakhte the (jaise Gautami Balashri ke naam par). 🌟 EXTRA GYAN: Gautamiputra = Gautami ka putra! Is chapter mein yehi ek tradition explicitly mention hoti hai (maa ka naam title mein). Kyun? Maa ka maan aur uski pehchaan darja dikhaana — aur shayad lineage matrilineal side se bhi jodna. Naneghat ki rani (widow queen) ka aśhvamedha karna bhi isi culture ka hissa tha. Is daur ki auratein — rani, maa, devi — sab active role mein dikhti hain!

text: Revision question 5 (khud ka rajya banane wala) humse kya sochne ko kehta hai?
options: Kaun sa raja sabse accha tha
